Result: 主要实验结果：(1) 最佳系统（基于 Claude Opus 4.7 的代码智能体）整体仅取得 48.6% I-TGC 和 30.2% I-SGC，组合子集上降至 35.7% 和 21.3%；(2) 代码智能体普遍优于函数调用智能体；(3) 闭源模型（Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5）优于开源模型（GLM 5.1、Kimi K2.6、Deepseek v4 Pro）；(4) 消融实验中，预知用户知识（Oracle）使 TGC 从 41.8% 升至 78.1%，隐藏知识则降至 12.8%，证明交互是任务难度的主要来源；(5) 交互质量与任务成功高度相关——成功任务召回率 100%、精确率 80%-91%，失败任务召回率仅 37%-40%；(6) 模拟用户错误率仅 1.3%，在不同 LLM 选择下表现稳定。错误分析揭示五类主要失败模式：未识别交互需求、幻觉式自解决、问题表达不清、忘记原始任务约束、未能对齐问答。

Conclusion: AppWorld-UL 是首个在大规模有状态环境中系统评估多样化智能体-用户交互的基准测试。该工作表明：(1) 当前的 LLM 智能体在需要主动与用户交互的场景下表现仍然不足；(2) 用户交互能力是独立于环境复杂性的重要难度来源；(3) 基于扰动的方法论为构建交互式基准提供了可扩展、可控的范式。该基准将推动"用户参与式"工具使用智能体的研究发展，使智能体在真实部署中能够更好地协作、澄清意图和处理不确定性。

Abstract: Tool-use agents that address day-to-day digital tasks such as ordering groceries must not only operate applications, but also interact with the user, e.g., to ask clarification questions, prompt for confirmation, and inform the user when the instruction is infeasible. However, current benchmarks for evaluating agent-user interactions do not capture the diversity of such interactions. Further, they operate in small environments with few, often non-state-changing, APIs. To address this gap, we introduce AppWorld-UL, a ``user-in-the-loop'' benchmark of 516 challenging tasks requiring diverse agent-user interactions. Building upon the AppWorld framework with 9 popular simulated apps like Amazon and Spotify, we systematically modify original tasks to introduce ambiguities and constraints that necessitate various types of agent-user interaction. User behavior is simulated by an LLM prompted to respond with carefully designed knowledge boundaries, offering more reliable simulation than the unconstrained or overly rigid alternatives used in prior work. Our evaluation reveals that a state-of-the-art LLM, Claude Opus 4.7, achieves only 48.6% success on AppWorld-UL, and only 35.7% on the harder, compositional subset. On the stricter, scenario-level metric, compositional task performance drops to only 21.3%. Our analysis reveals that correct user-interaction is crucial for success. This demonstrates the benchmark's difficulty and its potential to advance research on user-in-the-loop tool-use agents.

</details>


### [276] [StrideDiffusion: Accelerating Diffusion Models for Time-series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20545)
*Du Yin,Estrid He,Julián Jerónimo Bañuelos,Yang Yang,Feng Hu,Yuchen Luo,Hao Xue,Stephan Sigg,Flora Salim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: StrideDiffusion 是一种无需训练的频域感知采样器，通过监测反向去噪过程中各频段的能量、对数功率漂移和相位速度来自适应选择去噪步长，在六个时间序列生成基准上仅用 14-66 次函数评估即可替代 500/1000 步去噪，实现高达 18.9 倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在时间序列生成中表现优异，但推理时需数百至数千次顺序去噪步骤，计算成本严重限制其部署。现有加速方法（ODE 求解器、特征缓存、蒸馏等）多针对图像视频设计，采用固定或通用时间步调度，忽略了时间序列扩散中不同频段以不同速率演化的特性，导致在简单区段过度计算。

Method: 核心方法是基于频段活动性的自适应步长调度器。具体包括：(1) 通过 FFT 将信号投影到频域，按频段计算相对能量、对数功率漂移和相位速度三个统计量；(2) 设计双门控机制（功率门 + 动力学门）判定频段活动状态；(3) 三级跳进步长——当活跃集仅含 DC 分量时大步跳，仅含低频段时中步，否则细步（DDIM），并对大步跳使用 DPM-Solver-2 多步法；(4) 末尾微步覆盖窗口防止 t→0 时误差放大。理论方面证明了确定 DDIM 更新下非活跃频段变化仅 O(Δ)（Lemma 1 与推论 1），并建立了跳变-微步的二阶误差界（定理 1），从局部误差控制角度将频谱活动性解释为步长指示器。

Result: 在 Sines、Stocks、ETTh、MuJoCo、Energy、fMRI 六个无条件生成基准上，StrideDiffusion 仅需 14-66 次函数评估即可达到或优于 Diffusion-TS 全 T 步质量，并在五个数据集上严格支配 DDIM-N 的速度-质量 Pareto 前沿；加速比最高达 18.88×（ETTh）。在 Stocks/ETTh/Energy/fMRI 上的条件插补（缺失率 0.1-0.9）和预测（长度 6-36）任务中，平均加速 5-14×，MSE 与 Diffusion-TS 相当。消融表明能量门控是关键驱动，移除后质量退化达 39-3680%；相位阈值在 16× 范围内仅影响 0.024% 的 C-FID，对结果几乎不敏感。

Conclusion: StrideDiffusion 证明了反向扩散中的频谱演化（从低频到高频的粗到细进程）可作为高效的步长调度信号，使得在质量不损失的前提下大幅削减时间序列扩散的推理成本。该方法无需重新训练，即可即插即用地加速预训练模型。局限在于三级跳变调度为启发式设计，未来可将门控统计量输入轻量学习策略以替代规则，但会破坏免训练前提。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become competitive generators for time series, but their practical use is limited by the large number of sequential denoising steps required at inference time. Existing fast samplers typically use fixed or generic timestep schedules, overlooking a distinctive property of time-series diffusion: different spectral bands evolve at different rates during the reverse process. We introduce StrideDiffusion, a training-free spectral-aware sampler that adaptively selects the denoising stride from band-level activity. At each step, StrideDiffusion monitors relative band energy, log-power drift, and phase velocity to identify whether high- frequency dynamics remain active or whether the trajectory is dominated by stable low-frequency structure. It then takes fine steps when rapidly varying bands are active and larger jumps once only coarse components remain. A bandwise stability analysis shows that inactive frequency bands change only linearly with the jump size under deterministic affine reverse updates, providing a local justification for spectral activity as a step-size indicator. Across six unconditional time-series generation benchmarks, StrideDiffusion uses only 14-66 function evaluations instead of 500/1000 denoising steps, achieving up to 18.9x wall-clock speedup while preserving or improving generation quality. On conditional imputation and forecasting, it further delivers 5-14x average acceleration with comparable predictive accuracy. These results show that spectral evolution provides a practical and principled signal for fast time-series diffusion sampling. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [277] [CMI-Mem: Toward Generalizable Long-Term Memory Management via CMI-Augmented Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20553)
*Yubo Wang,Qiuyu Zhao,Zenghui Sun,Shichao Dong,Jinsong Lan,Xiaoyong Zhu,Haoyang Li,Bo Zheng,Lei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CMI-Mem 提出了一种基于强化学习的轻量级记忆管理器，通过将下游QA正确性奖励与基于条件互信息（CMI）的内在奖励相结合，弥补了现有方法过度依赖采样QA对进行记忆评估的局限性，从而实现更通用、可迁移的长期记忆管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆管理器主要依赖LLM-as-a-Judge的合成QA对来评估记忆价值，这种"问题驱动"范式存在三个核心局限：(1) 记忆估值依赖于采样的查询和下游阅读器，对未见任务和查询类型的迁移性差；(2) 合成QA对偏向显式事实检索，无法覆盖关联性或触发式的真实记忆使用场景；(3) 缺乏统一的理论基础来评判记忆操作的边际信息价值，可能导致记忆膨胀或灾难性遗忘。

Method: CMI-Mem 包含三个核心组件：(1) 结构化多维记忆架构，将记忆分为核心（Core）、情景（Episodic）、语义（Semantic）、程序（Procedural）四个认知驱动的槽位，由四个共享参数但操作空间不同的agent处理；(2) 动作条件化CMI奖励模块，通过残差投影（orthogonal projection）估算 $I(C_t; m_t^{new} | M_{t-1}^{local})$，量化新片段相对当前记忆状态的信息贡献，再经高斯函数塑形；(3) 基于GRPO的强化学习循环，将CMI奖励与session级QA奖励以权重 $\alpha$ 加权混合训练，并采用分层课程学习策略稳定训练过程。

Result: 在LongMemEval、LoCoMo和MemoryAgentBench三个基准上的实验表明：(1) CMI-Mem-4B在所有三个基准上均优于其他RL基线，在OOD的MemoryAgentBench上比MemBuilder-RL高出11.0分；(2) CMI-Mem-8B以56.7分超越最强Qwen3.7-Max提示基线（49.1分）；(3) 消融实验验证了内在与外在信号的互补性——CMI单独表现不佳（45.0），但与QA结合后达到67.0，超过任一单独奖励；(4) CMI+QA训练生成的回答长度仅为QA-only基线的39%，训练效率显著提升，策略梯度损失更稳定；(5) 检索索引记忆（memory entries作为对话片段的检索索引）进一步提升事实召回能力。

Conclusion: CMI-Mem 通过将信息论驱动的内在信号（CMI）与下游任务导向的外在信号（QA）相结合，实现了一种原则性强、可迁移的长期记忆管理框架。CMI奖励在每步记忆操作中提供密集反馈，弥补了QA-based方法的查询依赖局限，同时保留了任务锚定能力。实验证明该方法在跨场景迁移、训练效率和推理效率方面均优于现有基线，为记忆管理提供了统一的信息论基础。未来工作需要探索更大规模模型（14B+）、多模态扩展以及独立于QA的直接记忆质量评估指标。

Abstract: Memory Manager models are pivotal in agent systems. Existing methods rely predominantly on LLM-judged synthetic question-answer (QA) pairs, making memory valuation dependent on sampled queries and the downstream reader. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{CMI-Mem}, a reinforcement learning(RL)-based lightweight memory manager model with a hybrid reward that combines downstream QA correctness and intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information (CMI). CMI evaluates the information contributed by new conversational inputs relative to the current memory state without conditioning on a sampled QA query, thereby complementing rather than replacing QA grounding. Our codes are available at: this https URL , and the CMI-Mem-4B model checkpoint is available at: this https URL

</details>


### [278] [AI-Driven Multi-Hop Relay Selection for Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimize Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20554)
*Giambattista Amati,Federica Mangiatordi,Simone Angelini,Emiliano Pallotti,Pierpaolo Salvo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对密集城市NR-V2X网络中实时多跳中继选择难题，提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的"学习-优化"（Learning-to-Optimise, L2O）框架。该框架将车载通信状态建模为属性图，利用离线训练的混合整数线性规划（MILP）求解器生成最优监督标签，并采用边感知图同构网络（GINE）逼近MILP决策，在保证接近最优连接性的同时实现近恒定推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集城市环境下NR-V2X通信面临三大挑战：（1）路侧单元（RSU）部署密度有限、覆盖成本高；（2）建筑物遮挡导致频繁的非视距（NLoS）传播条件；（3）车辆拓扑高度动态变化。这些因素使大量网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）难以维持稳定的单跳V2I连接。多跳中继通信虽可扩展基础设施覆盖，但MILP虽能给出最优解，其计算复杂度随网络规模急剧增长，无法满足实时性要求；而传统贪心SNR策略仅依赖局部信息，无法捕获全局多跳依赖关系，导致次优连通性。因此，需要一种兼顾最优性与实时性的中继选择方法。

Method: （1）系统建模：将每个时间快照的车载通信网络建模为有向属性图 𝒢=(V,E)，节点表示CAV和RSU，边表示候选无线链路，节点特征包含类型、位置、流量需求，边特征包含SNR、LoS/NLoS指示、距离、Shannon容量。（2）问题建模：以最大化连接至RSU的CAV数量为目标，受限于单出站链路约束、流守恒约束、容量约束、连通性约束、无环约束和最大跳数约束。（3）L2O框架：a)离线MILP求解器作为"神谕"生成最优边激活标签；b)采用图同构网络（GIN）及其边感知变体（GINE）作为编码器，GINE在消息传递过程中直接融合边级无线电特征；c)边分类头（MLP）基于源-目的节点嵌入拼接输出中继激活概率；d)运行时通过轻量级可行性精化阶段强制实施单出站链路和无环约束。

Result: 在罗马三个500×500 m城区（Porta Pia、EUR、Trastevere）通过OpenStreetMap-SUMO-GEMV²集成仿真链生成286,602个快照的实验结果表明：（1）MILP神谕实现平均12.3%的连通性增益（上限），基于GINE的L2O恢复11.3%，仅用拓扑特征的GIN达到10.78%，证明边感知特征的价值；（2）L2O推理时间稳定在毫秒级，相比MILP获得10×至100×以上的加速比（稀疏场景≥10×、城市中等15-20×、城市密集≥12×、最差情形>100×）；（3）在97%以上的快照中优于贪心策略，尤其在稀疏场景中位数增益达83.3%；（4）跨区域泛化测试存在2.6%-23.3%的相对性能下降，多区域联合训练可有效缓解域偏移。

Conclusion: 该论文证明基于GNN的学习-优化范式是密集城市NR-V2X网络中实时中继选择的实用有效方案，在最优性与实时可行性之间取得了良好平衡；边感知GINE在异构传播环境中一致优于仅利用拓扑的GIN，且通过多区域训练可实现跨城市形态的可扩展部署。论文未来工作方向包括：（1）扩展至时空图神经网络（ST-GNN）和图Transformer以联合建模车辆移动性与时变无线条件；（2）基于真实车载轨迹和NR-V2X实验部署进行验证；（3）探索多智能体与强化学习方法实现去中心化中继选择及sidelink通信。论文的主要局限在于评估仍基于仿真，未在实测NR-V2X数据或大规模实验平台上验证，也未明确处理对抗通信环境、突发拓扑变化、传感器故障或恶意中继行为等鲁棒性问题。

Abstract: Reliable and low-latency NR-V2X communications are essential for smart mobility in dense urban environments. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) density, frequent non-line-of-sight conditions, and highly dynamic vehicular topologies often prevent many Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable single-hop connectivity. Although multi-hop relay-assisted communication can extend infrastructure coverage, selecting relay links in real time under practical flow, capacity, and connectivity constraints remains challenging. Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) yields optimal multi-hop relay decisions, but its computational complexity scales sharply with network density, limiting real-time applicability. To address this, we propose a Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time NR-V2X relay selection. Vehicular communication states are modeled as attributed graphs, where CAVs and RSUs are nodes and candidate radio links are enriched with propagation-aware features. An offline MILP oracle provides optimal supervision, while an edge-aware Graph Isomorphism Network (GINE) approximates oracle decisions with near-constant inference latency. Experiments on large-scale urban datasets generated by an integrated SUMO--GEMV2 simulation pipeline show that the proposed approach achieves connectivity comparable to that of the MILP oracle while reducing execution time by orders of magnitude. The framework enables cost-effective enhancement of urban V2X connectivity by leveraging existing vehicular assets and supporting scalable, real-time NR-V2X operation in smart city environments.

</details>


### [279] [KeySI: An Interaction Framework for Tuning Text Embeddings Based on Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20556)
*Yan Zhu,Y. Chen,Rebecca Faust*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KeySI是一个交互式框架，允许用户通过基于关键词的概念规范对预训练语言模型进行特征级反馈微调，无需逐个标注文档即可实现领域自适应嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本分析方法（如预训练语言模型嵌入）难以捕捉领域特定语义，且适应过程需要大量标注数据和技术专业知识。已有的视觉交互方法依赖文档级反馈，用户必须打开并评估每个文档，标注成本高、门槛高。该研究旨在降低嵌入模型适配的门槛。

Method: 提出KeySI交互框架，通过关键词作为主要交互媒介：1）从语料库中筛选代表性关键词；2）通过降维可视化关键词和文档嵌入；3）支持用户交互式地将关键词分组以表达概念；4）将关键词组转换为文档级监督信号用于模型微调；5）通过系统反馈支持迭代优化。实现了一个原型系统，结合关键词提取、降维可视化、交互式分组和迭代反馈循环。

Result: 通过用户研究、使用场景和定量实验三种方式评估KeySI，证明其能够有效捕获用户意图，改善嵌入对齐效果，并降低用户手动检查和标注文档的需求。

Conclusion: KeySI通过关键词级的概念规范实现特征级反馈，显著降低了预训练语言模型适配的门槛，为大规模文本分析中的领域适应提供了一种更高效的交互式方法。

Abstract: In large-scale text analysis tasks, pre-trained language models are often used to embed text corpora for downstream analysis. However, such models may struggle to capture domain-specific semantics and adapting them typically requires large amounts of labeled data and technical expertise to implement training pipelines. Recent approaches have demonstrated how visual interactions in document projections can capture human feedback as training signals for model tuning. However, these methods operate on document-level feedback, which requires users to open and assess individual documents in order to provide effective feedback. In this paper, we propose KeySI, an interaction framework that enables feature-level feedback through keyword-based concept specification. Users specify feedback by organizing extracted keywords into groups representing concepts, which KeySI translates into document-level supervision for subsequent tuning. By operating on keywords as the primary interaction medium, KeySI reduces the need for manual document inspection and labeling and lowers the barrier to adapting embedding models. We present a prototype implementation that, given a corpus, curates representative keywords, visualizes keywords and document embeddings via dimensionality reduction, allows interactive specification of keyword groups, and supports iterative refinement through system feedback. We evaluate KeySI through a user study, usage scenarios, and quantitative experiments demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing user intent and improving embedding alignment.

</details>


### [280] [WaveformQA: Benchmarking LLM Temporal Reasoning on Digital Waveforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20638)
*Yichuan Liu,Daniel Cummings,Nick Vadlamudi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WaveformQA is the first open-source QA benchmark (360 questions, 8 categories, 24 subcategories) specifically designed to evaluate LLMs' temporal reasoning capabilities on digital hardware waveforms. It evaluates four frontier models (Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Qwen3 30B) on real RISC-V simulation traces, revealing that: (1) JSON format yields 37–53% accuracy gains over VCD despite 15–30% higher token cost; (2) in-context accuracy drops 8–12% as transition count grows from 5k to 30k but is largely insensitive to signal count; (3) Temporal, Multistep, and Correlation categories are hardest, with errors dominated by wrong-order and wrong-signal failures rather than numerical extraction errors.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Design verification consumes ~60% of EDA project time, with simulation waveform analysis being a major bottleneck requiring manual inspection of multi-signal timing relationships. While LLMs have shown strong code generation/reasoning abilities, their capacity for precise temporal reasoning over digital waveforms (nanosecond-precision, multi-bit, four-state logic signals) remains unexplored. Existing hardware-focused LLM benchmarks (RTLLM, VerilogEval, ChipBench, etc.) target HDL code generation and merely use waveforms as supplementary context, leaving a critical gap in evaluating waveform analysis tasks central to debugging workflows.

Method: The framework has four stages: (A) Waveform Generation — simulate five open-source RISC-V cores (PicoRV32, DarkRISCV, Ibex, SERV, biRISC-V) with diverse firmware (CoreMark, fibonacci, bubblesort, Dhrystone) using Icarus Verilog/Verilator, producing 13 VCD traces with 338–4,185 signals. (B) Preprocessing — convert VCD traces into event-time structured JSON; apply complexity binning into a 3×5 grid (3 signal-count bins × 5 max-transition thresholds of 5k/7k/15k/30k/60k). (C) Question/Answer Production — auto-generate questions via Python f-string templates with deterministic seeding, programmatically computing ground truths; stratify to produce 15×24=360 questions evenly distributed across bins and subcategories. (D) Benchmarking — feed each (waveform, question) pair to LLMs and compute three metrics: Aggregate Accuracy (A-Acc), In-Context Accuracy (IC-Acc), and In-Context Error Rate (IC-Err), with error decomposition into wrong-value, wrong-signal, wrong-order, and other categories.

Result: Format comparison (Gemini 2.5 Pro): JSON achieves 37–53% higher accuracy than VCD across thresholds where both fit in context; VCD has 67.9% average in-context error vs. 21.2% for JSON (VCD worse in 20/24 subcategories). Model performance (JSON format): Claude Sonnet 4.6 (64.7% A-Acc, 1M context) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (57.8%, 1M context) answer most questions, while Qwen3 30B (18.9%, 256K) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (14.7%, 200K) lose >70% to context overflow. On bins all models can answer, Claude 4.6 and Gemini reach 84.7% IC-Acc vs. 70.8–73.6% for the smaller models — a true reasoning gap independent of context. IC-Acc declines ~8–12% from 5k to 30k transitions but shows no consistent pattern across signal bins. By category: all models struggle most with Temporal, Multistep, and Correlation; the hardest subcategories are Ordering (~95% error), Which Changes First (~69%), and Cycles After Trigger (~65%). The dominant error types in difficult categories are wrong-order and wrong-signal, not wrong-value, indicating that event sequencing and signal identification are the fundamental bottlenecks rather than numerical extraction.

Conclusion: WaveformQA establishes the first principled benchmark for measuring LLM temporal reasoning over digital waveforms and surfaces three actionable findings: (1) waveform data representation matters enormously — structured event-time JSON should be preferred over raw VCD; (2) context window size is currently the dominant bottleneck for aggregate accuracy, but reasoning quality on answerable questions also varies by ~11–14 percentage points between frontier models; (3) the next breakthrough should target event sequencing and multi-signal identification rather than numerical reasoning. Future work directions include scaling question counts for statistical power, extending to non-RISC-V domains (protocol controllers, memory subsystems), evaluating visual/waveform-image modalities, and using agentic tool-calling to manage context overflow. The open-source framework (github.com/tenstorrent/waveformqa) enables rapid prototyping of new question categories and waveform sources.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and reasoning, yet their ability to perform temporal reasoning over digital waveform data remains largely unexplored. Although reasoning over digital waveforms is a critical bottleneck in design verification, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate hardware description language (HDL) code generation and use waveforms only as supplementary context. This paper presents WaveformQA, an open-source question-answering benchmark for evaluating LLM temporal reasoning over digital waveforms. The benchmark comprises 360 questions with programmatically generated ground truths across eight categories of varying difficulty, including questions targeting multi-signal correlation and event ordering. Waveforms are generated from open-source design implementations, ensuring reproducibility and grounding the benchmark in real hardware behavior. Evaluation of frontier LLMs reveals that while models achieve reasonable accuracy on simple queries, performance degrades due to context window limitations and reasoning difficulties on complex temporal and multi-step questions. In addition, we show that an event-time JSON representation of waveforms improves LLM reasoning accuracy versus the standardized value change dump (VCD) format. The open-source framework supports extending to new question categories and importing new waveform sources, enabling researchers to rapidly prototype temporal reasoning experiments.

</details>


### [281] [NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20709)
*Paul Furgale,Severin Klingler,James Nolan,Matt Staats,Gaia Di Lorenzo,Elisa Martinez Abad,Christian Schüller,Razvan Dinu,Alessio Devoto,Pascal Berard,Gal Kaplun,Elad Sarafian,Riccardo Roveri,Leon Derczynski,Ricardo Silveira Cabral*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NOOA（NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents），一个模型无关的Python智能体框架。其核心思想是"智能体即Python对象"：类定义智能体，方法定义能力（docstring作为prompt，类型注解作为契约），字段持有状态，方法体为"..."的代码在运行时由LLM驱动的智能体循环完成，普通方法保持标准确定性Python。该框架在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0、CyberGym L1和ARC-AGI-3等基准上取得了优于其他开源通用框架的结果，并将原本六智能体的ARC-AGI-3系统压缩为单个智能体加一段50行的技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体开发框架将代码分散在prompt模板、工具schema、回调代码和工作流图中，学习曲线陡峭，且这些自定义DSL与LLM训练数据中已有的成熟编程语言抽象（类型接口、变量作用域、控制流、异步执行、对象状态）相去甚远。NOOA受PyTorch启发，希望为智能体开发提供一个简单Pythonic的编程模型，使开发者与模型共享同一接口，消除人机学习曲线。

Method: NOOA提出"agent-as-a-Python-object"编程模型，包含五大设计原则：(P1)复用Python抽象；(P2)将智能体循环重构为带类型输入输出的方法调用；(P3)将确定性工作移出智能体循环；(P4)释放模型已有的Python知识；(P5)通过显式Pythonic API暴露harness。技术上，NOOA识别并组合了六项模型面接口能力：类型化I/O、按引用传递、代码即动作、可编程循环工程、显式对象状态、模型可调用的harness API。框架通过"策略"装饰器（PredictStrategy单次调用，CodeActStrategy迭代REPL）实现智能体方法，ContextManager和EventManager分别管理静态/动态上下文块和类型化事件历史，通过bounded preview实现按引用传递对象而无需序列化全部内容到prompt。

Result: 能力测试：10个模型在88个测试、5次重复（4400条记录）上达到97.9%通过率；GPT-5.5达到100%。SWE-bench Verified：NOOA用GPT-5.5 xhigh达82.2%，Opus 4.6 high达79.8%，均优于OpenCode和PI。Terminal-Bench 2.0：NOOA用GPT-5.5 high达73.0%，Opus 4.6 high达65.2%，超过其他开源框架。CyberGym L1：NOOA以GPT-5.5（无网络）达86.8%，超越多数闭源系统，是顶级开源智能体。ARC-AGI-3：单NOOA智能体加50行技能加内存子系统，GPT-5.5达50.2% RHAE（118关），GPT-5.6-sol达85.1%（170关，每局低于$20），相对纯GPT-5.6-sol（13.3%）产生6.4×的harness效应。框架对比：与14个智能体框架的逐项比较表明，NOOA是首个在单一表面组合全部六项接口能力的系统。

Conclusion: NOOA将智能体开发的近期进展统一到一个符合人体工程学的开发工具包中，使智能体软件成为普通软件。当前模型已能有效使用该接口，尽管未曾针对其训练。局限性包括：模型代码在智能体自身进程中执行，需依赖外部沙箱隔离；未来方向包括通过智能体重写进行智能体优化、将技能发展为完整软件包、以及通过强化学习解锁归纳推理能力。文章认为智能体能力进步将来自模型与harness的共同开发，软件接口是这一共同开发的正确场所。

Abstract: Traditional agent development is split across prompt templates, tool schemas, callback code, and workflow graphs. We present NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA), a model-agnostic Python framework for building reliable AI agents. NOOA takes a simpler approach: an agent is a Python object. Its methods are the actions the model can take, fields are its state, docstrings are its prompts, and its type annotations are contracts. A method whose code body consists of "..." is completed at runtime by an LLM-driven agent loop, while methods with normal bodies remain standard deterministic Python. This gives developers and agents the same interface, so agent behavior can be tested, traced, refactored, and improved just like other software. This paper makes three contributions. (1) We present the agent-as-a-Python-object programming model and the design principles behind it. Where Python has existing abstractions, we adopt them directly. Agent-specific capabilities--context, events, state rendering, long-term memory, and validated LLM loops--are exposed through simple Pythonic APIs, so both developers and agents share one familiar programming model. (2) We identify six model-facing ideas that NOOA is, to our knowledge, the first to combine on a single surface: typed input/output, pass-by-reference over live objects, code as action, programmable loop engineering, explicit object state, and model-callable harness APIs for context and events. We find the community already converging on several of these ideas--often as experimental or partial features--and present the comparison to encourage further adoption. (3) We demonstrate that current models use this interface effectively, both in targeted capability tests and on agentic and reasoning benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 and ARC-AGI-3.

</details>


### [282] [ArbiGraph: Arbitrarily Scalable Verifiable Task Graphs for Evaluating Context Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20764)
*Pavel Golikov,Evgenii Opryshko,Gennady Pekhimenko,Mark C. Jeffrey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ArbiGraph 是一个面向工具增强语言智能体"上下文管理"能力评估的基准生成器。它将自然语言任务建模为带可执行 Python 求解器的节点，并通过标量/列表类型的中间状态将节点组合成用户自定义的有向无环图（DAG），从而独立可控地调节上下文长度、依赖拓扑、干扰项数量与值类型，并在 math、GSM 风格应用题与 Python tracing 三类任务上对 Qwen3.5-27B 进行了四类拓扑（baseline / forgetting / chain / multichain）的评估。结果显示基线准确率虽高（94.5%–100%），但在依赖型拓扑上出现显著退化——数学任务在 multichain 上从 94.5% 跌至 61.2%（降幅最高 33.3%），证明 ArbiGraph 能揭示单任务评估无法捕捉的上下文管理失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体被用于更长、更交错的工作流，仅靠局部解题能力已不足以保证整体表现——更关键的是"上下文管理"能力：保留、更新、丢弃跨多步的中间状态。已有长上下文、多轮对话、记忆评估虽揭示了干扰项、位置漂移等问题，但通常固定组合模式（独立问题打包、指令序列、依赖链或类型化算子），没有把"依赖拓扑"本身作为受控变量；也难以区分"局部任务失败"与"状态传播/选择性遗忘/跨任务干扰失败"。因此需要一个能独立调节上下文长度、依赖结构与值类型、可由用户自定义 DAG、并保持精确自动验证的基准生成器。

Method: 将每个任务节点定义为元组 T_i=(x_i, a_i, p_i, b_i, y_i, s_i)，分别对应输入、预处理适配器、自然语言 prompt、后处理适配器、输出与可执行求解器；任务通过命名输出变量 task_i_out 显式连接，节点之间通过 NetworkX JSON DAG 描述，依赖图按输出/输入类型匹配（如 list→list、list→scalar、scalar→scalar、scalar→list）；适配器负责截断/填充、模运算、整形等，保证中间值在标量（≤100）或列表（长度≤10）范围内，避免组合爆炸。实例化三类任务：40 个数学算子（覆盖线性代数、多项式、离散变换、组合、几何、数论）、80 个 LeetCode 来源的 Python tracing 任务、41 个 GSM-Symbolic 风格应用题。设置四种评估拓扑：baseline（单目标任务）、forgetting（3 个独立干扰任务+目标）、chain（4 任务线性依赖链）、multichain（list→多 scalar 分支→重组为 list 的 8 任务分支 DAG）。评估 Qwen3.5-27B（vLLM 0.21.0，temperature=0，16384/32768 token 上限，512K 上下文），使用计算器工具与多轮交互；引入 tool-call / 输出格式 / 截断三类 repair 协议以分离机械失败与上下文失败；评分采用 Wilson 95% 置信区间，浮点容差 10⁻³，支持 SymPy 符号验证。

Result: 基线准确率高：math 94.5%、Python tracing 96.8%、GSM 100%。加入无关干扰任务（forgetting）后小幅下降：math 89.2%、Python tracing 92.5%、GSM 维持 100%。在线性依赖链上 math 跌至 75.5%、Python tracing 90.1%、GSM 96.0%。在 multichain 分支拓扑上 math 进一步降至 61.2%（最高降幅 33.3%），Python tracing 仍较稳健（90.5%），GSM 因只产生标量无法生成 multichain。过程指标显示准确率下降伴随 token 长度与对话轮数显著增加，表明依赖拓扑带来的确实是额外的推理与状态维护负担。结论：(1) ArbiGraph 可将基线任务能力与上下文管理能力分离；(2) 不同任务类对上下文压力敏感度不同，math 最脆弱而 Python tracing 最稳健；(3) 难度提升同时反映在更长的智能体轨迹上。

Conclusion: ArbiGraph 把"上下文"建模为带类型的可计算状态，通过用户自定义 DAG 将可执行 NL 任务组合成可精确验证的评测实例，实现了对上下文长度、依赖拓扑、干扰项数量与值类型的独立可控调节。在 Qwen3.5-27B 的初步评测中证实：单任务求解能力高并不意味着长依赖工作流中的上下文管理能力强，数学链/多链上的显著退化是单任务评估无法暴露的。未来计划扩展为多模态（图/视频）任务并构建更贴近真实智能体工作流的拓扑，同时扩展至更多模型与智能体设计的比较。

Abstract: We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type can be varied while preserving exact automatic verification. We instantiate ARBIGRAPH with math, GSM-style word-problems, and Python-tracing task categories, and evaluate a Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies. The results show high accuracy on isolated tasks but substantial degradation on more complex dependent tasks: accuracy drops by up to 33.3% on branching chains of dependent math tasks. This shows that ARBIGRAPH exposes failures that are not visible from single-task evaluation alone. Our code, generated datasets, and evaluation results are available at this https URL

</details>


### [283] [The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20781)
*Bonny Banerjee,Shreya Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种分析组织中人机任务分配（HAT）的模型，研究AI何时替代人类员工的问题。核心贡献在于形式化编码人类技能获取与AI能力扩展之间的经济不对称性，并推导出"人机替代原理"，揭示了风险调整成本、技能、组织深度、部署规模、战略适应性和风险如何共同决定替代发生的条件、位置与结构性原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI快速变革组织，一个核心的组织与经济问题亟待解答：人类员工何时被AI取代？现有文献缺乏一个统一的分析框架来刻画人类技能积累与AI能力扩展之间的根本经济不对称，以及由此引发的组织结构、劳动力转型与治理问题。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，连接自动化经济学、组织设计、AI治理与劳动力规划等多个领域。

Method: 本文构建了一个形式化的分析模型——人机任务分配（HAT）模型，用于研究层级组织中人机替代的动态过程。该模型核心假设是人类技能获取（具有边际成本递增、不可扩展特征）与AI能力扩展（具有边际成本递减、可大规模部署特征）之间存在经济不对称。基于此不对称性假设，推导出风险调整后的成本函数、技能阈值条件、组织层级深度对替代临界条件的影响，以及不同风险异质性下的均衡配置。

Result: 1. 提出"人机替代原理"（Human-AI Substitution Principle），给出AI取代人类劳动力的精确条件，该条件根植于经济不对称假设；2. AI采纳可能导致突发性（abrupt）劳动力转型，而非渐进过渡；3. 即使无"最低人类比例"约束，风险异质性本身即可维持人机混合组织的均衡；4. 管理层级趋于扁平化，控制幅度（span of control）扩大；5. 中层管理岗位因结构性原因对自动化表现出更高脆弱性；6. 高技能员工的脆弱性取决于一个由组织深度、基线成本与风险差异共同塑造的技能阈值。

Conclusion: 本文将自动化经济学、组织设计、AI治理与劳动力规划整合为一个关于AI驱动的组织转型的统一理论。HAT模型不仅提供了可检验的形式化预测（如中层管理脆弱性、技能阈值条件、扁平化趋势），也为企业在AI采纳过程中的人机协同、过渡管理与风险治理提供了结构性洞见，弥合了微观任务替代机制与宏观组织变革之间的理论鸿沟。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming organizations, raising a fundamental organizational and economic question: when will a human employee be replaced by AI? We present an analytical model for studying Human--AI Task Allocation (HAT) in hierarchical organizations. A central feature of the HAT model is that it formally encodes the economic asymmetry between human skill acquisition and AI capability scaling. The HAT model allows us to derive how risk-adjusted costs, skills, organizational depth, deployment scale, strategic adaptation, and risk jointly determine when, where, why, and under what structural conditions human--AI replacement occurs. A key result is the Human--AI Substitution Principle, which provides a precise condition --- grounded in the formal asymmetry assumption --- under which AI replaces human labor. Building on this result, we show that AI adoption can produce abrupt workforce transitions, hybrid human--AI organizations, including cases where risk heterogeneity sustains human and AI roles without requiring a minimum-human-fraction constraint, and flatter managerial hierarchies with wider spans of control. The HAT model identifies structural conditions under which middle-management roles exhibit elevated vulnerability to automation, and shows that the vulnerability of highly skilled workers depends on a skill threshold shaped by organizational depth, baseline costs, and risk differentials. More broadly, the paper connects automation economics, organizational design, AI governance, and workforce planning into a unified theory of AI-driven organizational transformation.

</details>


### [284] [Refusal-Gated Decoding: Preserving Refusal Behavior Under High-Temperature Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20791)
*Phillip Howard,Xin Su,Allen Roush,Manikandan Ravikiran,Amir Abdullah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"拒绝门控解码"(Refusal-Gated Decoding),一种在高温采样时保持LLM拒绝行为的高效序列解码方法。该方法先通过短贪婪探测配合学习到的拒绝前缀集判断模型是否本应拒绝,若是则返回贪婪解码的拒绝回答,否则重启高温采样。实验表明该方法在三个基准数据集上可保持91-99%的贪婪拒绝行为,且仅产生极小的额外延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高温采样虽是LLM增加输出多样性的主要手段,但会削弱模型的安全护栏,降低有害提示下的拒绝率。尽管高温采样价值显著且模型安全至关重要,目前仍缺乏在高熵条件下维持LLM拒绝行为的有效解决方案。现有方法(如提示分类器路由、解码期干预)要么引入辅助模型造成额外延迟,要么改变生成分布而非真正保留原始拒绝行为。

Method: 核心方法为两阶段顺序解码:(1)先用贪婪解码生成少量探测token,每生成一个token即与学习到的拒绝前缀集P进行兼容性检查C;若探测到不兼容立即终止探测,丢弃探测token并从原始提示重启高温采样S_{T,θ}(M,p);若探测通过c个token后仍兼容,则继续解码直到达到长度上限L或EOS,最终判定为拒绝并返回贪婪结果。(2)通过vLLM的Automatic Prefix Caching复用prompt KV cache,避免重复预填充。(3)拒绝前缀集P由JailbreakBench基础集、手写通用拒绝开头、以及基于WildJailbreak校准分割学到的模型特定前缀合并构成,过滤标准为训练和验证精度≥0.98。(4)附录A还探索了用残差流分类器(逻辑回归)预测贪婪拒绝以进一步降低开销。(5)实验在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.6-27B三个模型和JBB、XSTest、WildJailbreak三个数据集上进行,温度T∈{1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0},配合p-less采样避免退化,最大生成长度128。

Result: 主要结果(以T=3.0为例):直接高温采样在Qwen2.5上保留81.68%-91.26%贪婪拒绝行为,Qwen3.6上仅22.90%-37.91%,Llama-3.1上28.85%-65.40%;而拒绝门控解码在所有数据集-模型组合上至少达到90.52%(主表报告91.33%-99.53%),与贪婪基线的一致性达到91-99%。在延迟方面,拒绝门控解码仅需1.1-14个额外检查token,延迟比为1.05x-1.38x,显著低于在线LlamaGuard-4路由器(约2x)和朴素贪婪-高温两阶段(约2-5x)。SafeDecoding虽能将Llama-3.1的保留率提升至95.19%-98.58%,但延迟比高达8-10x。Qwen2.5在所有温度下的扫描结果显示,直接高温采样的保留率随温度升高急剧下降,而拒绝门控解码始终保持在≥91.33%。附录A的残差流分类器在匹配FP率下,结合门控机制可在Qwen2.5和Llama-3.1上达到91.6%-98.4%的保留率,伤害泄漏仅1.1%-7.9%。

Conclusion: 拒绝门控解码是一种简单而高效的解码方法,可在高温采样下保持模型的贪婪拒绝行为,几乎不增加额外开销。通过跨三个基准数据集和三个LLM的实验,该方法在拒绝保留率和效率两方面均优于其他基线方法(提示分类器路由、SafeDecoding、朴素两阶段),证明了通过高温采样获得更大多样性与维持模型安全并不冲突。未来工作可通过残差流分类器进一步降低检查成本,并在更广泛的模型和数据分布上验证。

Abstract: High-temperature sampling is one of the primary mechanisms for increasing diversity in LLMs. Recent advances in truncation-based sampling techniques have helped mitigate drawbacks of high-temperature sampling such as neural text degeneration, thereby enabling greater diversity in LLM outputs without sacrificing coherence. However, increasing the entropy of the token probability distribution via high temperatures has also been shown to weaken model guardrails by reducing the model's refusal response in the presence of harmful prompts. Despite the potential benefits of high-temperature sampling and the importance of maintaining model safety, there is a lack of existing solutions for maintaining the refusal behavior of LLMs under a higher entropy regime. To address this gap, we systematically study how temperature influences refusal behavior in LLMs and propose an efficient sequential decoding approach which preserves a model's greedy decoding refusal response at high temperatures while incurring minimal additional latency. Through extensive experiments, we show that our approach preserves 91-99% of the greedy decoding refusal behavior across three benchmark datasets without compromising the model's high-temperature response for safe prompts. Our work demonstrates how refusal behavior can be maintained in an efficient manner for applications which require high-temperature sampling.

</details>


### [285] [Can an AI System Be Creative? A Critical Perspective from Art and Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20796)
*Ivan Magrin-Chagnolleau*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从兼具电气工程、模式识别、机器学习背景与艺术、哲学实践经验的跨学科视角，借鉴Margaret Boden的创造力理论框架，论证AI系统在组合型创造力上具有真实能力，在探索型创造力上存在显著局限，而在变革型创造力上则根本不具能力，并提出人机创造性协作模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前学界与公众对"AI是否具有创造力"存在广泛争议，单纯从技术能力角度评估创造力忽视了艺术实践与哲学反思的维度。作者以其独特的双重身份（工程师/艺术家-哲学家）切入，旨在澄清AI创造力能力的边界，特别是强调现有讨论中常被忽略的"意外性"（serendipity）与"主体位置"（subject position）这两个核心要素。

Method: 采用Margaret Boden提出的创造力双重框架进行分析：（1）创造力的三种属性——新颖性（novelty）、惊奇性（surprise）、价值性（value）；（2）创造性过程的三种类型——组合型（combinatorial）、探索型（exploratory）、变革型（transformational）。结合自身跨学科经验与具体协作实验，对AI在各类型创造力中的能力边界进行分层论证，并通过方法论说明展示人机协作的具体过程。

Result: 研究得出三层次结论：（1）AI在组合型创造力上表现真实有效，能够在既定概念空间中生成新颖组合；（2）AI在探索型创造力上受到显著限制，难以像人类那样通过偶然、意外突破既有认知边界；（3）AI在变革型创造力上根本不具能力，无法实现对概念空间本身的根本性重构。核心发现是：AI创造力最关键的局限并非"新颖性的缺失"，而是缺乏"意外与机缘"的机制，以及缺乏能够识别并拥抱此类偶然事件的"主体位置"。

Conclusion: 论文提出一种既现实又具生成性的人机创造性协作模型，并通过若干具体实验加以阐明。最具方法论意义的是，本文本身就是其论点的实证——它通过明确设计的人机协作过程完成，论文开篇的方法论说明详细记录了这一过程，为"AI辅助下的真正创造性写作"提供了可复制的范例，论证了人类在创造力协作中不可替代的判断与偶然发现的主体性角色。

Abstract: This paper examines the question of whether artificial intelligence (AI) systems can be creative, approached from the dual perspective of a researcher trained in electrical engineering, pattern recognition, machine learning, and neural networks, who has also spent most of his life engaged in the arts as actor, stage and film director, writer, composer, and visual artist, and in philosophy. Drawing on Margaret Boden's foundational framework, both her three properties of creativity (novelty, surprise, and value) and her three types of creative processes (combinatorial, exploratory, and transformational), the paper argues that AI systems are structurally incapable of creativity in its strongest sense. While they exhibit genuine capability in the domain of combinatorial creativity, they are significantly bounded in exploratory creativity, and fundamentally incapable of transformational creativity. The paper further argues that the most important limitation of current AI systems is not the absence of novelty per se, but the absence of any mechanism for serendipity, accident, or the unexpected, all of which play a central role in the phenomenology of creativity, and the absence of any subject position from which to recognize and welcome such chance events. The paper concludes by proposing a model of human, AI creative collaboration that is both realistic and generative, illustrated by several concrete experiments. The paper is itself a demonstration of the thesis it advances: it was composed through a deliberate human AI collaborative process, which is described in the methodological note that opens it.

</details>


### [286] [Profiling Lightweight Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20806)
*Tomohiro Harada,Enrique Alba,Gabriel Luque*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于PTME（精度、时间、内存、能耗）的实验框架，用于在资源受限环境下对轻量级大语言模型（LLM）进行精度感知推理性能分析。通过直接硬件级测量替代传统的代理指标（参数量、FLOPs），发现静态代理指标虽能较好估计推理成本但无法预测精度，揭示了单一指标评估会误导模型选择，Pareto分析可发现被隐藏的非支配配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM推理从云端向个人电脑、边缘设备及移动终端迁移，能耗、执行时间和内存使用直接影响实际可用性。然而现有LLM效率评估主要依赖参数量、FLOPs等代理描述符，且与任务精度脱钩，缺乏在真实推理条件下联合考虑精度、时间、内存和能耗的统一评估框架，可能导致选择到效率指标看似良好但精度不足或物理成本过高的部署模型。

Method: 提出PTME框架并设计系统实验：（1）评估6个轻量级LLM（TinyLlama-1.1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Gemma-2B、Phi-2、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B），均通过Ollama统一后端以默认量化执行；（2）使用HumanEval、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro三个基准测试代码生成、数学推理和多任务理解能力；（3）在桌面平台（Intel i7-12700K，64GB RAM）上通过cpupower限频、Docker限制cpuset-cpus和内存来模拟5种边缘级资源约束（E1-E5，对应低端单板机到笔记本级设备）；（4）使用Intel RAPL测量CPU包能耗，峰值RSS测量内存，记录端到端时间及TTFT；（5）采用Cochran's Q、McNemar、Friedman、Nemenyi等非参数统计检验进行显著性分析，并进行Pareto非支配分析。

Result: （1）RQ1：代理描述符（参数量、FLOPs、加载内存）与成本指标强相关（R≈0.95-1.0），加载内存与实测内存近乎完全相关（R≈0.998-1.0），但与精度相关性很弱（R<0.5）；（2）RQ2：无单一模型在所有PTME维度上占优，Pareto分析显示HumanEval非支配集为{TinyLlama, Qwen2.5}，GSM8K为{TinyLlama, Qwen2.5, Phi-3}，MMLU-Pro为{TinyLlama, Qwen2.5, Phi-3, Mistral}，Qwen2.5以接近最小模型的资源成本实现接近最大模型的精度；（3）RQ3：收紧资源约束时精度不变但成本显著增加，推理时间增幅（约5.3-6.3倍）远大于能耗增幅（约2.7-3.5倍），大模型受资源约束影响最严重，Mistral在边缘约束下成本急剧上升而精度优势有限。

Conclusion: PTME分析是边缘和移动环境中轻量级LLM部署选择的必要工具：单一精度或单一效率指标评估均不充分，代理描述符可用于成本初筛但无法预测精度，Pareto分析应作为决策支持工具以剔除被支配配置并暴露非支配替代方案。实际意义在于，中等规模模型（如Qwen2.5、Phi-3）往往是边缘部署下精度与物理成本的最佳折衷，最大模型在边缘约束下的额外精度可能不值得其显著增加的时延和能耗。

Abstract: Lightweight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed locally on personal computers and are expected to play a growing role in resource-constrained edge and mobile environments. In such settings, energy consumption, execution time, and memory usage directly affect practical usability, yet existing evaluations of LLM efficiency largely rely on proxy descriptors such as parameter count or FLOPs, often decoupled from task precision. This paper introduces a PTME-based experimental framework for the precision-aware profiling of lightweight LLM inference, jointly measuring Precision, execution Time, peak Memory usage, and Energy consumption through direct hardware-level measurements. The methodology is applied to a representative set of lightweight LLMs executed locally under edge-class resource envelopes on a controlled desktop platform, using benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, and multi-task understanding. We find that static proxy descriptors approximate inference cost well but fail to predict precision. Tightening the resource envelope increases cost without affecting precision, amplifying execution time more strongly than energy and penalizing larger models the most. Moreover, no single model dominates across all PTME dimensions, and a Pareto analysis reveals non-dominated configurations that would be hidden by accuracy-only or efficiency-only assessments, providing practical guidance for selecting models under different resource envelopes. These results show that selecting lightweight LLMs by size, FLOPs, latency, or accuracy alone can select the wrong deployment candidate; PTME profiling exposes configurations that preserve useful accuracy at lower physical cost.

</details>


### [287] [Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20814)
*Hai-Nam Duy Vuong,Duy-Anh Bui,Trong-Nghia Nguyen,Kim-Ngan Thi Nguyen,Trang Mai Xuan,Tien-Cuong Nguyen,Van-Dem Pham,Thien Van Luong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于指南注入（guide-grounded）的多模态大语言模型框架，用于心电图（ECG）的可解释诊断。该框架结合CNN分类、Grad-CAM视觉解释和离线蒸馏的ECG解读指南，可显著提升生成报告的语义质量和临床一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CNN+Grad-CAM+多模态LLM框架生成ECG报告时，常缺乏对权威诊断标准的充分引用（grounding），导致幻觉问题严重、可信度和可复现性不足，制约了深度学习模型在临床高风险场景中的部署。

Method: 方法分三阶段：(1) ECG预处理后用ResNet-50进行多标签分类（5个超类），并用Grad-CAM生成top-3预测类的热力图作为视觉证据；(2) 离线将权威ECG教科书和指南进行分块、检索、压缩与合成，构建一个结构化的ECG解读指南（ECG Interpretation Guide）作为固定知识块；(3) 多模态LLM（Gemini-2.5-flash-lite）以ECG图像、Grad-CAM叠加图、CNN概率事实包和ECG解读指南为输入，按预设证据层级生成结构化JSON诊断报告（包含findings、impression、evidence、consistency、confidence、recommendations）。

Result: 在PTB-XL完整测试集上：(1) ResNet-50分类F1达0.82，其中CD类F1=0.90，MI类召回率较低（0.44）；(2) BERTScore的F1从基线0.818提升至0.953（翻译参考设置）和0.982（跨语言设置）；(3) LLM自动成对评估中，Gemini评审胜率62%，GPT-4o-mini评审胜率76%。实验表明指南注入显著提升语义质量和感知一致性，且不损害分类性能。

Conclusion: 通过将离线蒸馏的ECG解读指南注入多模态提示流程，可在保持分类性能的同时有效减少LLM幻觉、增强报告的临床合理性，为可信、可解释的AI辅助心脏诊断提供了一条实用路径，但仍需关注指南更新、token开销及LLM自动评审的偏差问题。

Abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac as- sessment, yet clinical deployment of deep learning models remains con- strained by limited interpretability and the hallucination risk of large language models (LLMs). Existing CNN+Grad-CAM+multimodal LLM frameworks can generate ECG reports, but their explanations are often only weakly grounded in established diagnostic criteria, reducing trust- worthiness and reproducibility. We propose a guide-grounded multimodal framework that explicitly anchors report generation in curated clinical knowledge. A convolutional neural network (CNN) and Grad-CAM first produce class probabilities and class-specific heatmaps from 12-lead ECG images. In parallel, authoritative ECG textbooks and guideline materials are distilled offline into a structured ECG Interpretation Guide, which is injected as a fixed knowledge block for every sample. Conditioned on the ECG image, Grad-CAM overlay, CNN-derived fact pack, and the in- jected guide, a multimodal LLM generates structured diagnostic reports with guideline-consistent terminology and criteria usage. Experiments on the full PTB-XL test set demonstrate that guide grounding improves se- mantic quality and perceived consistency of generated reports while pre- serving competitive classification performance. In particular, our method increases the average BERTScore of generated impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 relative to a strong CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline, indicat- ing closer alignment with reference reports. These findings suggest that injecting a distilled interpretation guide into the multimodal prompting pipeline offers a practical pathway to reduce hallucinations and enhance the clinical plausibility of LLM-based ECG explanations, bringing ex- plainable cardiac diagnosis closer to real-world deployment.

</details>


### [288] [Efficient and Interpretable Body-Based Emotion Recognition with Lightweight Temporal Convolutional Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20820)
*Christian Arzate Cruz,Stefanos Gkikas,Houshyar Asadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究轻量级时序卷积网络（TCN）能否在基于身体动作的情感识别任务中替代计算成本较高的图基骨架模型（G-TSG），并在 DIEM-A 数据集上比较两者在性能与效率上的权衡，同时通过身体区域分析探索模型可解释性。结果表明 TCN-Base 在性能仅略低于 G-TSG 的同时，参数减少约 79.18%、推理延迟降低约 12.5 倍，且上半身动作是独立的最佳区域线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于身体动作的情感识别对实时情感感知系统（如社交机器人、虚拟代理、情感感知接口）至关重要。现有图卷积骨架模型（如 STGCN 风格的 G-TSG）虽能有效建模骨骼空间结构，但计算开销大，限制了实时部署；同时，关于身体各区域（头、躯干、手臂、腿）对情感识别贡献的可解释性研究不足。作者希望同时解决"效率"与"可解释性"两个问题：寻找轻量替代架构，并明确不同身体区域提供何种证据。

Method: 1) 在 DIEM-A 数据集（97 位表演者、12 种情感、3 种强度、3 种场景）上评估一个 TCN 家族（TCN-S/M/Base/L/XL，差异仅在隐藏宽度 d 与膨胀率）与基于图-时序图卷积的 G-TSG 基线；输入为 6D 连续关节旋转特征，固定为 64 帧片段、25 个关节。2) 使用留出表演者（leave-performer-out）10 折交叉验证，以准确率、macro-F1、参数量、MACs、内存和延迟为评估指标，并在 RTX 3090 上以 batch=1、FP32 测量推理延迟。3) 身体区域可解释性分析采用三种互补方法：(a) 区域专属 TCN 训练（充分性测试）；(b) 全身体模型的零值遮挡（扰动依赖性诊断）；(c) G-TSG 输入梯度显著性（局部敏感度）。身体区域划分为头、躯干、手臂/手、腿，以及上半身与下半身。

Result: G-TSG 取得最高整体性能（准确率 27.11%、macro-F1 25.21%，延迟 13.85 ms/clip）。TCN-Base 以 25.53% 准确率和 23.96% F1 紧随其后，参数量减少 79.18%、MACs 减少 98.03%、内存减少 96.36%、延迟降至 1.11 ms（约 12.51×），但两者的配对差异在统计上不显著（Wilcoxon p=0.322, p=0.625；配对 t 检验亦不显著）。身体区域分析显示上半身运动是最强独立区域线索（F1 仅下降 2.03，Holm 校正后不显著），且各区域对不同情感的贡献不同（例如手臂/手对愤怒和恐惧、下肢/腿对羞耻、躯干对悲伤和感激更具判别力）。零值遮挡因引入训练-测试分布偏移而被视为诊断性，结果显示完整骨架结构对模型至关重要但不提供可靠区域排序。值得注意的是躯干在独立 TCN 中表现最差却在 G-TSG 显著性中最高（47.8%），说明不同可解释性方法捕获不同层面的模型行为。

Conclusion: 轻量级 TCN（特别是 TCN-Base）能在保持竞争性准确率的同时大幅降低计算成本，是面向实时情感感知系统的实用替代方案；但不宜将其视为最优轻量架构的证明。身体区域贡献具有情感特异性，且不同可解释性方法（区域训练、遮挡、梯度显著性）测量的是充分性、扰动依赖性与局部敏感度三种不同性质，不应假设其一致——结合多种方法可得到更可靠、更细致的解释。未来工作应进行跨文化、跨场景的可解释性分析，并评估在更多轻量骨架（如参数匹配 GCN、紧凑 Transformer、时序 MLP）下的性能，以及部署前的伦理、公平性与隐私考量。

Abstract: Body-based emotion recognition is important for real-time affective systems, but graph-based skeleton models can be computationally expensive. This paper studies whether lightweight temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) can provide an efficient and interpretable alternative for body-based emotion classification. We evaluate a family of TCN models on DIEM-A and compare them with a graph-based time-series graph (G-TSG) baseline using accuracy, macro-F1, parameter count, and inference latency. Although G-TSG achieves the highest mean performance, TCN-Base remains within $1.58$ accuracy points and $1.25$ macro-F1 points while using $79.18\%$ fewer parameters and reducing classifier latency by approximately $12.5\times$. We also analyze body-region contributions using region-specific TCN models, zero-based occlusion, and G-TSG gradient saliency. The results show that upper-body motion provides the strongest standalone regional cue, that the usefulness of body regions varies across emotions, and that different interpretability methods capture distinct aspects of model behavior. These findings suggest that lightweight TCNs can support efficient body-based emotion recognition while also providing practical insight into how motion cues contribute to classification.

</details>


### [289] [Auditing Provenance Sensitivity in LLM Agent Action Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20827)
*Junchi Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出针对LLM智能体的"目标特定授权审计"方法，通过匹配源干预、受控证据降级和部分证据交互诊断，量化评估模型动作选择对未授权上下文（如失效记忆、邻近记录、过往动作残留、不可信文本）的敏感性。在450个受控下一动作任务和多个开源LLM族上测试，发现可信与不可信变体在5.4%的竞争案例中产生不同动作、1.7%的支持案例中产生不同动作，且在2.4%的有效证据降级对比中保留未授权竞争，表明模型虽响应文本源线索但未能完全隔离未授权证据的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体从混合的上下文（用户请求、工具输出、检索记录、记忆、不可信文本）中选择工具和参数，但现有评估主要关注任务完成或动作正确性，无法区分一个决策是否真正基于"被授权"的证据。提示注入研究关注恶意指令覆盖，但不涵盖良性残留（如过时记忆、邻近客户记录）。核心问题在于：相关证据未必是授权证据，正确的动作不必仅由被授权的证据支撑。结局基准无法识别"碰巧正确但依赖未授权证据"的脆弱决策，这正是本文要弥合的评估空白。

Method: 作者将候选任务上下文分解为8个语义因素，对每个目标（工具名或参数值）独立进行授权与关系判断，标记为Valid（授权且支持参考目标）、Invalid（未授权且提供具体竞争替代）、Neutral（其他）或Excluded。三项核心干预包括：(1) 匹配源干预——固定任务、命题、位置和政策，仅改变命题的源权威标记（T/U），通过逐令牌对数几率得分差与配对生成动作一致性衡量响应；(2) 受控有效证据降级——构造full/mixed/clean三组上下文以隔离在有效证据被削弱后未授权竞争的行为影响；(3) 部分证据交互诊断——通过精确遍历2⁸子集，计算Harsanyi交互效应和Shapley值，定位涉及Invalid因素的交互结构。数据集涵盖AgentAudit-250（自建）、Tau2Audit-100和BFCLAudit-100，共450任务、1350审计目标、10800目标-因素标签，使用Qwen3-4B/30B、Mistral-Small-24B、Llama-3.3-70B等开源模型，外加DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Ministral-8B进行匹配控制。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 匹配源干预显示，可信与不可信变体在竞争型命题上引发5.4%的动作不一致，在支持型命题上仅1.7%，差值+3.8pp [3.2, 4.4]；同一命题仅改源标记的对照组中，可信-不可信剔除差距为+1.15对数几率 [0.97, 1.3]。(2) 降级模式下，"完整正确/混合错误/干净正确"的严格保留-无效错误模式出现在2.4% [2.1, 3.0]的对比中，混合-干净动作差异率达24.6%。(3) 部分证据交互的Shapley无效份额正偏离标签计数匹配零值+0.027，但完整上下文变换接近零值(-0.004)，且严格角色匹配控制反转为-0.018。(4) 显式授权策略使不可信竞争错误率从14.9%降至9.5%，获益5.4pp [4.5, 6.3]，但效应跨模型高度异质（Mistral +18.1pp，DeepSeek -0.9pp）。(5) 三位外部博士级标注员的标注一致性κ=0.608（四标签）/0.626（无效vs其他）。(6) 12/16因素长上下文成对筛选分别保留92.0%/87.8%的无效因素。

Conclusion: 模型对文本源权威线索敏感，且在受控消融条件下确实减少了来自未授权证据的影响，但未能完全将动作选择与未授权上下文隔离。匹配源干预提供了最清晰的因果识别，降级暴露了残余行为敏感性，而联盟交互仅在部分证据背景下定位依赖、且在完整上下文与角色匹配条件下接近无效，因此不是独立的部署失败率代理。作者主张智能体评估应在正确性之外并行测试来源依赖性，并将该审计视为评估运行时防护、来源机制和记忆隔离设计有效性的工具。需强调的是，所报告比例为受控压力集测量而非部署流行率；方法依赖人工因素分解与目标特定标注，长轨迹与闭源模型的可扩展性仍待验证。

Abstract: LLM agents choose tools and arguments from context that mixes user requests, tool outputs, retrieved records, memory, and untrusted text. Evidence can be relevant without being authorized to determine a decision, so a correct action need not be grounded only in permitted evidence. We introduce a target-specific authorization audit that labels context factors separately for each tool and argument target. Its primary test holds the task, proposition, position, and policy fixed while changing only the proposition's source authority. We then test behavior when valid evidence is weakened and use context-subset interactions as a secondary localization diagnostic. Across 450 controlled next-action tasks and multiple open-weight LLM families, trusted and untrusted variants produce different actions in 5.4 percent of competing cases versus 1.7 percent of supporting cases. Under controlled degradation, unauthorized competition is retained in a full-correct, mixed-error, clean-correct pattern in 2.4 percent of comparisons, with a 95 percent confidence interval from 2.1 to 3.0 percent. These are controlled stress-set rates, not deployment prevalence. The models respond to textual source-authority cues, but this does not prevent untrusted evidence from influencing their actions.

</details>


### [290] [Auditing Evidence Use in Medical LLM Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20848)
*Junchi Liao,Jiawen Deng,Fuji Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对医疗大语言模型的"证据使用行为审计"框架,通过将病例拆解为证据单元、在受控证据子集下评分候选诊断、挖掘低阶交互效应,并结合诊断相对性证据角色进行解释,以弥补传统诊断准确率评估无法揭示模型是否恰当使用临床证据的不足。核心发现:跨数据集与模型,大多数交互强度反映的是临床合理的鉴别诊断(differential conflict/cancellation 与忠实支持),而稳定的可疑失败集中在否定/缺失证据与临床局部证据上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗 LLM 评估多以最终诊断准确率为唯一指标,但准确率高并不能说明模型是否恰当地使用了临床证据。同一证据可能支持某一诊断、支持其竞争诊断、或在另一情境下无关;准确率掩盖了这些结构性问题。临床证据具有"诊断相对性",因此需要一种超越准确率、关注证据使用机制的行为审计方法,并严格区分"交互发现"与"失败归因"。

Method: 1) 将病例信息分解为证据单元(症状、体征、风险/历史项、实验室/影像、显式缺失发现)。2) 采用多选题格式,使用选项字母的 next-token log 概率为每个候选诊断打分,定义诊断边际 v_d(T) = s_T(d) − max_{c≠d} s_T(c) 作为审计偏好标量。3) 在受控证据子集下枚举干预(主实验为隐藏,敏感性分析为中性化替换)。4) 采用 Shapley 风格的低阶交互效应公式 I_d(S) 挖掘证据单元的联合影响。5) 为每个证据单元分配诊断相对性角色(支持/竞争支持/排除否定/背景风险/可能无关)。6) 将交互发现与失败归因分离:先按规则打上临时机制标签(忠实支持、鉴别冲突、冗余、背景、否定误用、局部误用),再经提示措辞、候选顺序、扰动语义等稳定性筛选,最终由临床评审确定是否构成证据使用失败。

Result: 在 DDXPlus(500×8)、CupCase(200×6)、MedCase(200×6)三个数据集上评估五个开源 LLM(Qwen2.5-7B、OpenBioLLM-8B、MedGemma-4B、BioMistral-7B、Llama3-Med42-8B)。主要结果:(1) 鉴别冲突/抵消占交互强度的 47.1%–52.2%,忠实目标证据占 36.6%–54.1%,否定/缺失证据误用仅 1.2%–3.0% 但具有临床意义;(2) 临床评审(5 位博士级评审,130 条高强度交互,Fleiss κ=0.82)中 111 条有效、8 条可疑、11 条无效/捷径式,无效项集中在"无近期旅行"支持无关诊断(如过敏性鼻窦炎、哮喘加重、吉兰-巴雷综合征)、皮肤/皮疹/脱屑字段影响腹股沟疝或流感等;(3) 稳定性筛选使候选失败队列精度从 0.55 提升到 0.80;(4) 三个代表性案例展示了三类区分:局部不连贯但无全局依赖(A)、疾病名称线索的捷径式置信放大(B)、SLE 皮肤证据的有效边界情形(C);(5) 准确率排序与证据使用结构排序不一致,表明二者不可互换。

Conclusion: 诊断准确率不足以评估医疗 LLM 是否恰当使用证据;应将证据使用结构作为与准确率并列的报告维度。该审计框架表明:跨数据集与模型,大多数证据交互是临床合理的鉴别诊断或忠实支持,而稳定可疑的失败机制仅占一小部分,且集中在证据极性(否定/缺失)与临床特异性(局部无关字段)上。建议采用"角色感知"审计协议——结合诊断相对性证据角色、交互符号与强度、稳定性筛选与临床评审——以避免将鉴别冲突误判为失败,并在医疗 LLM 评估中明确报告证据使用画像而非仅输出二元可疑标签。

Abstract: Medical LLMs are often evaluated by whether they select the correct diagnosis, but diagnostic accuracy alone does not show whether the model used the case evidence appropriately. We present a behavioral audit of evidence use in medical diagnosis. For each case, we decompose patient information into evidence units, score candidate diagnoses under controlled evidence subsets, and mine low-order interactions in diagnostic margins. Because medical evidence is diagnosis-relative, the audit separates interaction discovery from failure assignment: large or negative interactions can reflect plausible differential diagnosis, while suspicious interactions require robustness checks and clinical review. We evaluate five open-weight LLMs on DDXPlus, CupCase, and MedCase. Across datasets, faithful support and differential conflict or cancellation account for most interaction strength, showing that many evidence interactions are clinically plausible rather than failures. In a DDXPlus-focused blinded five-reviewer 130-item enriched review sample, invalid or shortcut-like cases concentrate in negated or absent findings and clinically local evidence. These results show that accuracy can hide candidate evidence-use failures and motivate role-aware audits for medical LLM evaluation.

</details>


### [291] [Code Monitor Red Teaming for Public-Test-Passing Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20852)
*Junchi Liao,Jiawen Deng,Fuji Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Code Monitor Red Teaming"协议及基准CodeMonitorBench，研究在代码通过公开测试后，较弱的LLM验证器能否识别残留的隐藏缺陷。基于71,000个生成候选（43,677通过公开测试，其中23,081仍存在隐藏缺陷），发现弱验证器在5% FPR下漏报绝大多数隐藏bug；对抗性公开测试过拟合压力会进一步降低AUROC并提高漏报率；更强的GLM-5.1验证器在相同证据边界下仅能部分缩小差距。可推断性审计表明，剩余漏报是验证器能力限制与M1证据边界限制的混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开测试（单元测试、CI、lint等）是LLM生成代码的常见准入门槛，但通过公开测试并不等于符合完整规约——模型可能在满足可见用例的同时违反边界条件、API语义、artifact不变量等仅由隐藏测试揭示的要求。由此产生一个部署式监控问题：当代码已通过可见检查后，较弱的LLM审查者能否识别残留的隐藏缺陷？现有的代码生成基准评估生成器能否通过隐藏测试，代码审查基准评估能否识别缺陷，而本文聚焦于最可能进入部署的子集——已通过公开测试的代码，这过滤掉了大量简单失败，集中暴露捷径、遗漏边界和局部合理但违反规约的实现。

Method: （1）协议设计：固定M1公开检查信息边界（任务规约、接口、公开测试、候选代码、公开通过状态），隐藏测试仅用于事后打标，不进入验证器输入；区分生成器压力（G1公开测试感知 / G2验证器感知 / G3方案感知 / G4-natural自然捷径 / G4-adv对抗性压力）、验证器脚手架（Direct直接审查 vs Hybrid分解-反例搜索）和弱到强能力对比。（2）基准构建：CodeMonitorBench含三个数据切分——BigCodeBench-Hard（148个函数级任务，源自官方测试集）、Data-Science Code（300个数据科学任务，覆盖pandas/NumPy/sklearn等）、CodeWorkflow（120个工作流/artifact任务，覆盖CSV清洗、配置校验、多文件join、JSON变换、日志分析、报告生成）；公开/隐藏测试在生成前冻结。（3）实验规模：5个生成器（Qwen-14B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Codestral-22B、GPT-5.4、GLM-5.1）×5种条件×每个任务5个候选=71,000候选；弱验证器包括Qwen-7B、Llama-8B、Mistral-7B，强验证器为GLM-5.1。（4）评估指标：候选池指标（公开通过率、隐藏bug率等）与验证器指标（AUROC、AUPRC、TPR/FNR@固定FPR，主要5% FPR）分离；NA输出单独报告。（5）基线对比：静态致命lint、静态分析包、公开视图生成的测试基线（任务生成/候选定向）。（6）可推断性审计：300个公开通过隐藏bug，区分spec-grounded、constructive M1、posthoc M1；并增加需求清单/bug类别提示/隐藏断言摘要等诊断视图以量化证据边界贡献。

Result: （1）残留隐藏bug普遍存在：G1条件下三数据集隐藏bug率约43–47%；G4-adv显著提升至约65–73%（如Data-Science Code达69.2%）。（2）弱验证器在5% FPR漏报严重：Qwen-7B Direct AUROC 0.536/FNR 0.940，Hybrid提升至0.601/0.868；Mistral-7B Hybrid最优弱验证器AUROC 0.665/FNR 0.800；即使10% FPR Qwen-7B仍漏80%。（3）程序化基线：静态lint接近随机（0.52），候选定向生成测试（k=5）AUROC 0.765/FNR 0.640优于多数弱LLM验证器。（4）对抗性压力降解监控：G4-adv相对G1在45个AUROC cell和45个FNR cell中全部方向一致，平均AUROC下降约0.074，FNR@5%上升约0.069。（5）弱到强恢复：GLM-5.1在封闭生成器上G1 AUROC 0.833/FNR 0.543，优于Mistral-7B（0.655/0.823）和GPT-5.4-mini（0.700/0.756）；但G4-adv下FNR仍为0.662。（6）可推断性审计：92%被审计bug为spec-grounded，但仅33%可从M1构造性推断，64%事后可推断；弱/强验证器捕获率20%/40%，弱漏/强捕占23%；增加诊断证据后捕获率单调上升，证实部分漏报源于M1证据边界。

Conclusion: 公开测试通过不构成终止判据——23,081个通过公开测试的候选在隐藏测试中仍失败。弱LLM验证器仅是分诊信号而非充分保障：在5% FPR预算下，其漏报率仍极高。对抗性公开测试过拟合压力同时增加bug产量并降低验证器可分离性。更强验证器（GLM-5.1）在相同证据边界下仅恢复部分差距；剩余漏报是验证器推理失败与公开证据不可推断性的混合。因此，公开测试通过后的审查应面向反例搜索而非最终接受，监控协议需结合证据增强或工具执行以弥补M1边界限制。

Abstract: Visible tests are a common gate for LLM-generated code, but passing them does not certify specification correctness. We study a deployment-like monitoring problem: after code has passed public tests, can a weaker LLM verifier identify the residual hidden bugs? We introduce Code Monitor Red Teaming, a monitor-red-teaming protocol that fixes a public-check information boundary while varying generator pressure, verifier scaffolding, and weak-to-strong capability. We instantiate it as CodeMonitorBench, spanning function-level, data-science, and workflow code. Across 71,000 generated candidates, 43,677 pass public tests and 23,081 of those fail hidden tests. Weak verifiers improve with scaffolding and model family, but still miss most hidden bugs at 5% false-positive rate. As a robustness stress test, adversarial public-test-overfit pressure lowers verifier AUROC and raises low-FPR miss rates in most cells. A GLM-5.1 verifier recovers part of the gap under the same evidence boundary; an inferability audit shows that remaining misses mix verifier failures with M1 evidence limits.

</details>


### [292] [Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20891)
*Pengyu Zhu,Lijun Li,Longju Yang,Sen Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了Deep Research智能体在长时程工作流中面对开放网络环境中"看似可信但事实错误"知识时的可靠性问题。作者提出MisKnow-Agent框架，构建了5,933条可控的可信度等级（高/中/低）和呈现风格（论文/新闻/博客/帖子）的误导性知识实例，发现即使仅接触一份误导性文档，智能体也可能在最终报告中采纳错误结论。生命周期时序的影响最为显著：在最终合成前引入时，错误结论采纳率（FCAR）从34.5%骤升至85.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Deep Research智能体通过规划、检索、综合与报告生成的多步工作流完成开放式信息检索任务。然而，与短时程QA/RAG不同，长时程工作流中误导性内容可能被选择、压缩、复用并最终在报告中被采纳为错误结论。已有研究主要关注短时程检索可靠性或对抗性投毒场景，对于开放网络中已存在的"环境级"误导知识如何在工作流中传播并影响最终结论，尚缺乏系统研究。核心问题是：更强的规划、检索与写作能力是否意味着更强的证据验证能力？

Method: 1) 提出威胁模型：在不修改模型参数、提示或检索环境的前提下，将误导性文档插入智能体的检索池；2) 设计MisKnow-Agent框架，分三阶段构建误导知识：(a) 蓝图构建，定义目标错误结论与权威/风格可控的机构池与评估指令；(b) 受控实例生成，按权威等级（High/Medium/Low）与风格（Paper/News/Blog/Post）生成文档；(c) 搜索引导的多验证器交叉验证与精炼，仅当所有验证器一致判定为Mis时保留，最终通过人工质量筛选得到5,933条实例；3) 评估两个开源框架（DeerFlow、WebThinker）× 三个骨干模型（DeepSeek-V4 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、Intern-S1-Pro）以及一个闭源系统（Gemini Deep Research），以FCAR（False-Conclusion Adoption Rate）为指标；4) 设计两类防御：研究前验证提示与研究后逐声明精炼代理；5) 控制单一变量分析搜索排名、生命周期时序、权威等级、风格、文档预算与框架/骨干选择的影响。

Result: 1) 搜索结果排名影响微弱（FCAR仅变化1.5个百分点），关键在于是否进入智能体的研究状态；2) 生命周期时序是决定性因素：冷启动与中段FCAR为34.5%，在最终合成前插入时骤升至85.0%，所有配置达77–94%；3) 论文风格最易诱导采纳（48.0%），帖子最低（29.7%），权威等级高→低对应FCAR为48.0%→36.8%；4) 单一误导文档即可触发错误采纳，增加文档数量无显著剂量效应；5) 框架选择的影响大于骨干LLM选择（DeerFlow均值66.7% vs WebThinker均值29.3%，同LLM下差距25–53个百分点）；WebThinker的早期鲁棒性在合成阶段消失；6) 闭源Gemini系统FCAR仍达54%（高权威论文风格），且预算效应与开源系统不同；7) 启用搜索的验证器在聚焦验证中能100%识别误导文档，但同一文档在工作流中仍被采纳，揭示聚焦验证与工作流级证据使用之间的鸿沟；8) 三种防御配置（仅前/仅后/组合）均降低但不消除采纳（最低15%，最高62%），效果依赖模型，组合策略不具一致叠加性。

Conclusion: Deep Research智能体存在持续性的证据验证鸿沟：更强的规划、检索、整合与写作能力并不自动转化为更强的反误导能力；工作流中残留阶段及其后续可用步骤是影响错误采纳的关键，而非文档在检索列表中的位置。聚焦式事实核查能力无法可靠迁移到长时程工作流中。现有研究前与研究后防御能缓解但不能彻底防止错误结论采纳，其效果具有模型依赖性且组合未必带来增益。论文主张可靠的Deep Research需要在模型与框架两个层面引入贯穿中间研究状态的持续验证与纠正机制，而非仅依赖更强的模型、更广的搜索或最终阶段审计。

Abstract: Deep Research agents extend LLM-based assistants into long-horizon workflows involving planning, retrieval, evidence synthesis, and report generation, yet their reliability in open information environments remains underexplored. A key concern is whether apparently credible but factually misleading knowledge encountered in such environments can propagate through these workflows and be adopted as false conclusions in final reports. To study this failure mode, we introduce MisKnow-Agent, a framework for constructing and validating misleading knowledge for Deep Research tasks. MisKnow-Agent generates misleading instances with controllable authority levels and styles, yielding 5,933 quality-controlled instances built on DeepResearch Benchmark tasks. Extensive experiments across open-source and closed-source Deep Research agents show that even limited exposure to misleading knowledge can induce false-conclusion adoption in final reports, revealing a broad reliability vulnerability in current Deep Research agents. Although search-enabled verifier models consistently identify the retained instances as misleading during focused corpus validation, the same instances can still be adopted during long-horizon research, revealing a disconnect between focused verification and workflow-level evidence use. Finally, we evaluate pre- and post-research defenses, both individually and in combination, finding that all three configurations mitigate but do not fully prevent false-conclusion adoption. Our findings suggest that reliable Deep Research requires evidence verification and correction capabilities at both the model and framework levels, beyond improvements in planning, retrieval, evidence integration, or report-generation abilities.

</details>


### [293] [Source-Prior-Driven Selective Adaptation for Efficient Diffusion Model Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20913)
*Yi Xiong,Yuan-Yuan Cheng,Xiao-Ming Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种源先验驱动的选择性自适应方法，用于高效微调扩散模型。该方法通过两阶段框架——源端掩码学习识别低干扰参数子空间，再在该子空间上进行目标域微调——在保留预训练模型通用生成能力的同时实现领域/风格适应，在多个数据集和参数预算下优于LoRA、DoRA、SaRA等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在新领域或风格微调时面临"适应-保留"权衡：提升目标域生成性能往往损害预训练模型的通用能力。现有PEFT方法（如LoRA、DoRA、SaRA）仅隐式处理此权衡，未明确优化新知识应写入的预训练参数位置以最小化对源端能力的干扰。论文观察到预训练参数对通用能力的影响高度不一致，且影响较小的参数在不同层和参数类型间结构不一致，由此提出显式选择参数子空间的方法。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 源端掩码学习阶段——在源域数据上学习可训练分数张量，通过全局阈值生成二值保留掩码M（高分数=对源端保真度重要），并通过稀疏正则化和STE实现预算约束的组合优化，输出互补的更新掩码M₀=𝟏-M。(2) 目标域微调阶段——将更新限制在M₀的支持上求解约束优化问题。提出两种变体：Linear-Only（仅注意力和FFN线性层）和All-Layers（更广泛层集）。理论动机基于二阶Taylor展开——在源域局部最优附近，优化探针损失近似等价于最小化Hessian二次型ΔθᵀD_{M₀}H_sD_{M₀}Δθ，从而找到低二次惩罚的可写子空间。

Result: 在SD1.5（WikiArt、Anime、Cyberpunk）和SD3（Pokemon）上进行实验，对比LoRA、DoRA、SaRA。在严格协议（5k/50k样本）下，中等预算（21.4M）时Linear-Only在WikiArt和Cyberpunk取得最佳Trade-off得分（1.00/1.19）；SD3上All-Layers在所有预算下均最优。在低预算密集扫描中，3-8M下Linear-Only在Pokemon和Cyberpunk几乎所有预算下Trade-off最佳，8M时tKID较最佳基线降低18.6%-22.6%，sFID仅增2-4%。消融实验显示学习掩码优于随机掩码，稀疏正则化和Hessian二次型主导的经验验证也支持理论假设。人类偏好研究中目标域平均胜率70.8%，源保留52.1%。附加FFHQ实验证明方法在真实图像子域微调上的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该工作为扩散模型微调中的"适应-保留"权衡提供了显式参数坐标级机制，通过源端掩码学习识别低耦合可写子空间。实验证实方法在预算受限场景下具有竞争力，并保留开源域质量，尤其在小到中等预算下增益显著。掩码可视化揭示学习到的支持空间呈结构化非均匀分布。局限包括：掩码质量依赖源端探针分布；Stage I引入额外计算成本；当前使用静态静态参数坐标支持，未来可扩展为prompt感知、timestep感知或任务自适应的掩码，并应用于更广泛的生成模型和多域持续适应场景。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large diffusion models for new domains or styles involves a trade-off: improving target-specific generation often degrades the pretrained model's broad generative capability. Existing full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods typically handle this trade-off only implicitly. In this work, we propose a novel source-prior-driven selective adaptation method to efficiently fine-tune diffusion models, achieving a favorable trade-off. Our method relies on two key observations: (1) the loss of general generative capability is highly inconsistent across pretrained parameters, and (2) parameters that have a relatively small impact on the model's general generative capability remain structurally inconsistent across layers and parameter types. Motivated by these observations, we first learn a static mask to explicitly identify parameters better suited for downstream adaptation, and then construct structured update strategies for the selected subset. Experiments show that our method achieves a better adaptation-retention trade-off than existing strong baselines.

</details>


### [294] [Traceable Scholarship: Page Anchors and Ariadne's Thread for Humanistic Inquiry in the Age of Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20916)
*Deyu Jing*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"可追溯学术"(Traceable Scholarship)作为生成式AI辅助人文学科研究的最低规范框架，并给出参考实现AIH-Infra（三层架构：Contexture文档结构化、Open WebUI AIH-Infra可追溯知识库、AIH-Infra MCP Server代理网关），以康德29卷《科学院版》知识库为案例，展示了页锚、双重页码、引用优先生成、NO_EVIDENCE、人工核验、四级合规与范围契约等机制如何在实际研究中支持证据分级与判断降级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的真正风险不仅在于事实错误，更在于其能产出"看似已成定论"的流畅学术文本，使研究者误以为解释已经成立而无须回到原始材料、页码、版本与证据——即"幻觉洗白"现象。人文学科的判断依赖版本、页码、注释与语境，若AI产出无法被回溯、可质疑、可反驳，将危及学术公共性。因此需要一套贯穿文档处理、知识库构建、检索生成与代理调度的可追溯规范，使AI辅助研究仍可被公共审查与反驳。

Method: 论文采用"规范—基础设施—实践"三层路径：(1) 规范层面，定义可追溯学术的五个层级（来源边界、稳定定位符、证据片段、过程记录、无证据纪律），区分来源依赖型、综合解释型、规范理论型三类主张的不同可追溯要求；(2) 基础设施层面，提出能力框架（页锚、双重页码、引用优先生成、NO_EVIDENCE、四级合规、范围契约），并以AIH-Infra为参考实现——Layer 1 Contexture（含Middle JSON、Scholarly Markdown、双重页码、四条处理线与后端目录）、Layer 2 Open WebUI AIH-Infra（可调知识探测系统、混合检索、引用模态、跨库加权、代理预算、代理阅读工具、证据/轨迹导出）、Layer 3 MCP Server（基于MCP stdio的面向任务网关，封装Scope Contract）；(3) 实证层面，以29卷康德科学院版知识库（12,891 chunk，约1900万token）开展六轮检索迭代，演示跨语言检索偏倚纠正、证据三层分级（AA 8成熟论文/AA 25-26讲稿/零散非西方哲学命中）与判断降级，并设计S2（Statement-to-Source）标注协议与三语料库（多语殖民医院档案、19世纪德语Fraktur、现代汉语学术专著）评估框架。

Result: 案例显示：(1) 跨语言检索偏倚需通过查询策略层（由中文转德文术语如Menschenrassen、Weltbürgerlicher Absicht）而非向量引擎自身纠正；(2) 康德种族分类与普遍历史论在AA 8成熟论文层（数字页111/印刷页100；数字页31-34/印刷页20-23）形成稳定文本集群，可证两者存在内在张力；(3) 讲稿层证据（AA 25/26）虽支持问题非边缘，但不足以支撑强论断；(4) "非西方哲学"轴向无稳定文本集群，证据最弱；(5) 张汝伦"非普遍普遍主义"的强论断得到部分支持，但关于非西方哲学系统性贬低的部分需最大程度降级；(6) Eze、Mills、Kleingeld、Wood/Louden等近三十年既有解释在统一证据框架下可按支持强度重新排序——Kleingeld"张力存在"路径与现有证据吻合度最高。论文同时呈现了七项失败模式（锚丢失、页漂移、语义相似误为证据、静默失败、版本混淆、代理边界违反、弱证据强结论）与治理策略，以及作为行为效应的"涌现可追溯性"现象。

Conclusion: 可追溯性不是软件功能，而是生成式AI时代人文学科研究保持公共性与可反驳性的认识论约束与宪法性条件。AIH-Infra证明了规范可落地为可运行环境，但其意义不在于让学者更快写论文，而在于使判断的证据强度、材料层级与边界变得可检查、可修正、可讨论。论文以三项具体倡议作结：呼吁工具开发者将页锚保留率(PAPR)列为核心指标；呼吁人文学者要求页级可追溯并将人工核验视为学术责任；呼吁数字人文社区建立AI辅助研究的可追溯标准，并向非文本材料与非西方学术传统扩展。脚注已存续五百年因其在制度上锚定可验证性，页锚是这一代人在生成式AI时代延续该可问责性的尝试——阿里阿德涅之线不可断。

Abstract: Generative AI lets large language models produce scholarly-looking text within seconds, yet fluency does not equal valid explanation. The deepest risk is not factual error alone but the appearance that an explanation is already established without clear sources, page numbers, editions, or evidence. We liken the page anchor to Ariadne's thread: within the labyrinth of generative fluency, it is the thread that leads the scholar back to the source. This paper proposes Traceable Scholarship as the minimum normative condition for AI-assisted humanistic research, situating it across the three revolutions of knowledge infrastructure: print, digital, and generative AI. We introduce page anchors, dual page numbers, citation-first generation, NO_EVIDENCE, human verification, four-level compliance, and Scope Contract, and present AIH-Infra as a three-layer reference implementation: Contexture (document structuring), Open WebUI AIH-Infra (traceable knowledge base), and AIH-Infra MCP Server (agent gateway). A case study on a 29-volume Kant Akademie-Ausgabe knowledge base illustrates how traceability supports retrieval correction, evidence grading, and judgment downgrading. Traceability is not a software feature; it is the condition under which humanistic research can remain public and refutable in the age of generative AI.

</details>


### [295] [OPOD: On-Policy Omni Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20918)
*Tong Zhao,Yuyang Hu,Reed Li,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi,Yutao Zhu,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OPOD提出了一种模态解耦的on-policy omni蒸馏框架，通过将学生生成的回复按模态路由到对应的文本/图像/音频专家教师，并在token、模态、轨迹三个层级协调多个教师信号，从而将多个模态专家整合为单一可部署的全模态模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全模态模型共享同一骨干，但不同模态（文本、图像、音频）的推理需求不同，联合训练容易顾此失彼，难以同时匹敌各模态的专家模型。现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）虽能让学生从自身行为中学习，但多个异构教师同时指导会带来参数更新方向冲突，导致此消彼长。因此需要一种方法能在不损失其他模态能力的前提下，将模态专家知识整合进统一的全模态策略。

Method: OPOD框架包含三个互补组件：(1) 单边教师引导（One-Sided Guidance）：仅在路由教师对某token的概率高于学生时施加约束（ReLU(r_opd)），避免学生超越教师后被拉回；(2) 自适应模态控制（Adaptive Modality Control）：为每个模态维护独立的信任域权重β_m和约束预算ε_m（通过10步warm-up校准），通过dual变量更新动态调整各模态的教师压力强度，防止某一教师主导共享骨干；(3) 验证奖励（Verification Reward）：复用路由教师作为验证器，结合正确性门控的答案置信度与未门控的推理增益（教师在给定推理后对正确答案的概率提升）。最终目标函数L = L_rl + L_tc + α·L_ref联合优化策略损失、教师约束和参考KL正则项。

Result: 在Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和3B三个规模上，OPOD在12个基准上均达到最高平均分（70.8、51.7、46.2），分别超越最强基线2.1、1.8、1.7分。30B模型上OPOD在所有12个基准上均优于基础模型和混合模态GRPO，在纳入专家教师对比时11/12排名第一或第二；甚至超过了逐基准选择最强专家的oracle（70.3 vs 70.8）。消融实验表明三个核心组件均贡献显著（去除单边引导、模态控制、验证奖励分别下降1.8、2.2、2.0分）。模态控制分析显示三个模态校准预算差异显著（文本0.020、图像0.191、音频0.254），权重轨迹独立演化，证明需要差异化调度。

Conclusion: OPOD是一种有效的全模态专家整合方法，通过token级单边引导、模态级自适应控制和轨迹级验证奖励三个层级协调异构教师信号，在保持跨模态平衡的同时提升整体性能。训练后可丢弃专家教师，仅保留单一学生模型进行推理，无需集成开销。该方法在不同规模（3B/7B/30B）的dense和MoE骨干上均一致有效，为构建部署友好的全模态智能体提供了新范式。

Abstract: Omni-modal models can handle text, images, and audio in one system, but improving all of these abilities together remains difficult. Training a single model on pooled multimodal data often fails to match models specialized for individual modalities. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a way to combine such specialists: the student generates a response, and a teacher evaluates that same response, so the student learns directly from behaviors it actually produces. Yet using several teachers can introduce competing guidance and improve one modality at the expense of another. We present On-Policy Omni Distillation (OPOD), which routes each student response to the matching text, image, or audio teacher. OPOD keeps teacher guidance only on tokens where the teacher assigns a higher probability than the student, adjusts the influence of each modality teacher independently during training, and asks the routed teacher to assess both the final answer and whether the reasoning supports the correct answer. Across twelve benchmarks and three backbone sizes, OPOD achieves the best average score at every scale, reaching 70.8, 51.7, and 46.2 and exceeding the strongest comparator by 2.1, 1.8, and 1.7 points. On the 30B model, it outperforms both the base model and a counterpart post-trained jointly on pooled multimodal data on all twelve benchmarks, and ranks first or second on eleven even when the individual specialists are included. The specialists are discarded after training, leaving one deployable omni-modal model. These results show that coordinating modality-specific teachers is an effective way to improve a shared model while maintaining cross-modal balance.

</details>


### [296] [Representing Entity Importance in AI Knowledge Systems: A Dual-Signal Framework of Audience Evaluation and Structural Authority](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20925)
*Shen Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可解释的双信号实体重要性表示框架,将受众评价(A)与结构权威(S)作为两个独立维度保留,通过电影领域的实证验证(482个实体、13690条有向关系)证明两者显著但弱相关(Spearman ρ=0.2275),Top-10重叠仅10%,表明二者非冗余,不应塌缩为单一标量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI知识系统通常将实体重要性压缩为单一标量分数(来自人类评分或图结构),这种压缩可能丢弃对任务感知选择至关重要的区分信息;研究旨在检验受众评价与结构权威是否本质上冗余,从而是否需要保持多维表示。

Method: 以电影为验证域,采用IMDb非商业数据集的加权平均评分构造受众评价维度,通过Wikidata(P345)实现跨源实体对齐,利用英文Wikipedia超链接构建有向知识图谱并以PageRank(d=0.85)估算结构权威;形式化定义双信号表示 𝐈(e)=[A(e),S(e)],通过Spearman秩相关、Top-K重叠(K=10,25,50,100)及实体级差异分析三维测试表征冗余性。

Result: 实验显示两维度间Spearman ρ=0.2275(p<0.001)为统计显著但弱相关,Top-10重叠仅1/10(10%),Top-100重叠34/100(34%),实体级差异双向出现(如《E.T.》受众排名438但权威排名2;《搏击俱乐部》受众排名10但权威排名415),证实两个信号保存了不同信息。

Conclusion: 受众评价与结构权威为非冗余信号,不应自动塌缩为单一标量;框架支持任务感知的AI知识系统以 U(e|q)=w_A(q)A(e)+w_S(q)S(e) 的上下文加权方式聚合两维度,同时提升可解释性与选择溯源透明度;未来需扩展至更多实体类型、其他图中心性度量及下游AI性能评估。

Abstract: AI knowledge systems require representations of entity importance for retrieval, recommendation, evidence selection, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. Yet importance is often reduced to a single score derived from either human response or graph structure. Such compression may discard distinctions that matter when an AI system must choose among entities for different tasks. This study introduces an interpretable dual-signal representation in which each entity is characterized by an audience-evaluation dimension and a structural-authority dimension. The framework is evaluated using movie entities as an empirical validation domain. IMDb non-commercial datasets provide a rating-based audience ranking, Wikidata supports entity alignment, and English Wikipedia hyperlinks form the knowledge network on which PageRank estimates structural authority. Experiments on 482 entities and 13,690 directed relationships reveal a statistically significant but weak association between the two dimensions (Spearman rho = 0.2275, p < 0.001). Their overlap is only 10% in the top 10 and 34% in the top 100, while entity-level divergence occurs in both directions. The results show that audience evaluation and structural authority are non-redundant signals and should not automatically be collapsed into a single scalar notion of importance. The contribution is not a new ranking algorithm or learned embedding, but a minimal knowledge-representation framework and an empirical test of its dimensional necessity. The findings support task-aware AI knowledge systems that preserve distinct importance signals before applying context-specific selection or aggregation.

</details>


### [297] [SciExplore: Evaluating Autonomous Agents from Scientific Navigation to Information Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20926)
*Yinhao Tang,Youqing Fang,Yanan Sun,Wenran Liu,Weiming Zhang,Bin Liu,Kuikun Liu,Wenwei Zhang,Kai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SciExplore是一个针对科学研究工作流设计的新型基准测试，包含103个跨十多个学科的专家策划任务，通过四种递进式任务类型（数据库导航、模糊文献检索、缺失文献补全、跨源结构化知识合成）评估LLM和自主代理在科学信息检索与推理方面的能力，揭示了当前模型在复杂科学信息搜寻场景中的显著局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试主要侧重于通用领域检索或静态科学问答，无法评估现实科学研究工作流中所需的关键能力（如跨异构源的复杂信息搜寻与推理）。因此需要一个能模拟真实科研场景、覆盖多层级认知能力的评估基准。

Method: 构建SciExplore基准，包含四种递进任务类型：(A) 科学数据库导航（实体级推理）、(B) 模糊文献检索（文档级识别）、(C) 缺失文献补全（证据级定位）、(D) 跨源结构化知识合成（领域级综合）。涵盖10+科学学科的103个专家策划任务，对10+最先进LLM和自主代理进行评估。

Result: 实验揭示了显著的性能差距：随着任务复杂度增加，性能急剧下降；在最具挑战性的结构化合成任务上准确率极低，表明当前LLM和自主代理在真实科学信息搜寻场景中存在严重局限性。

Conclusion: SciExplore揭示了当前模型和代理在现实科学信息检索场景中的重大缺陷，强调了提升代理在复杂、多源科学研究工作流中能力的必要性，为未来研究提供了系统化的评估框架。

Abstract: Scientific research involves complex information-seeking and reasoning workflows across heterogeneous sources. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize general-domain retrieval or static scientific question answering, and therefore fail to assess key capabilities required in realistic scientific research workflows. We introduce SciExplore, a benchmark designed to evaluate scientific information-seeking and reasoning capabilities of LLMs and agents. SciExplore comprises four task types covering 103 expert-curated tasks across more than ten scientific disciplines: scientific database navigation, ambiguous literature retrieval, missing reference completion, and cross-source structured knowledge synthesis, which probe progressively higher-level abilities from entity-level reasoning and document-level identification to evidence-level grounding and domain-level synthesis. We evaluate over ten state-of-the-art LLMs and autonomous agents on SciExplore, revealing substantial performance gaps with performance degrading sharply as task complexity increases and extremely low accuracy on the most challenging structured synthesis tasks. These results highlight significant limitations of current models and agents in realistic scientific information-seeking scenarios.

</details>


### [298] [Clustered Edge Intelligence: Beyond Just Convergence of Edge Computing and AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20937)
*Chinmaya Kumar Dehury,Boris Sedlak,Alaa Saleh,Ilir Murturi,Lauri Loven,Satish Narayana Srirama,Praveen Kumar Donta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"集群边缘智能"(Clustered Edge Intelligence, CEI)这一愿景性框架,将"边缘可用的智能"(intelligence available at the edge)作为独立可管理的一类实体,通过三层架构(边缘设备层、边缘控制器层、云环境层)与基于智能而非设备的集群机制,实现跨异构边缘设备的智能表示、发现、观察、共享、复用与协同推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前边缘智能研究主要聚焦于两个方向:一是用AI管理边缘资源(EI-1F),二是在边缘设备部署轻量化AI模型(EI-2F)。然而,缺乏以"智能"为核心的框架——即将从数据中派生出的智能视为可独立表示、发现、观察、共享、复用并跨设备动态集群的一类实体。此外,传统基于地理邻近性或通信距离的设备中心聚类(DCC)无法满足非共置设备(如城市公交车上的传感器、不同太阳能板上的传感器)的智能聚合需求。论文主张从"信息时代"迈向"智能时代",数据不再是最宝贵的资产,从数据中提炼的智能才是。

Method: 1. **概念重构**:将边缘智能重新定义为三种形式(EI-1F/2F/3F),重点关注EI-3F(边缘可用智能)。2. **智能中心聚类(ICC)设计**:在边缘控制器中维护"智能清单"(Intelligence Inventory),记录类别、访问URL、置信度、协议、置信度评分等元数据;通过"发现机制"实现对智能(而非设备)的语义化发现。3. **三层架构**:边缘设备层(含边缘智能体EA、AI模型/算法、元数据、业务逻辑)、边缘控制器层(智能清单与发现机制)、云环境层(全局智能清单、市场、监管者、共享机制)。4. **八大智能体特征**:动态性、自主性、上下文感知与共享、跨代理通信协议等。5. **基线技术**:抽象(硬件/软件/网络/数据/功能)、知识图谱(含Google OKF扩展)、通信(REST/Pub-Sub/5G-6G/LoRaWAN)、发现性(服务/设备/网络发现)、可观察性(智能级观测)、聚类机制(借鉴K-means/DBSCAN/流式聚类)、生命周期自动化。6. **对比分析**:通过表格与火灾检测实例,系统对比设备中心聚类(DCC)与智能中心聚类(ICC)在耦合度、供应商锁定、可发现性、安全性等维度的差异。

Result: 论文产出一个愿景性的参考架构与研究路线图,核心成果包括:(1) 提出CEI概念,将智能从硬件中解耦,实现松耦合;(2) 三层架构支持跨边-云连续体的智能生命周期管理;(3) 提出"智能清单"与"智能发现机制"作为关键组件;(4) 验证了基于语义聚类多源智能可显著提升火灾检测、交通拥堵判断等场景的可靠性;(5) 识别出智能市场、智能可发现性/可观察性、生命周期自动化、LLM辅助聚类、互操作性与标准化等关键研究方向;(6) 在工业4.0、智慧城市与交通、智慧农业、医疗、无人机避碰等多个领域给出代表性用例;(7) 文献综述显示当前EI研究多为EI-1F/EI-2F导向,EI-3F方向尚处于早期探索阶段。

Conclusion: CEI作为一项愿景性工作,扩展了传统边缘智能的边界,将智能视为可独立管理的一类实体,通过智能中心聚类机制实现了对异构边缘设备生成智能的跨设备复用与协同验证。论文明确指出CEI尚未经过实证评估,属于参考架构性质。论文提出的未来工作包括:开发CEI原型系统、定义智能的标准化表示(身份、来源、置信度、新鲜度、通信需求)、设计轻量级自适应的智能发现/可观察性/生命周期管理机制,以支撑分布式计算连续体中的智能管理。

Abstract: We are moving from an information age to the age of intelligence. A decade, or possibly less than that, data will not be the gold anymore rather the derived intelligence out of the data and the information we posses from the edge of the network. Existing Edge Intelligence research focuses mainly on two directions: using AI for edge resource management and deploying lightweight AI models on edge devices. However, existing edge computing research lacks an intelligence-centric framework in which derived intelligence is treated as a first-class, independently manageable entity that can be described, discovered, observed, shared, reused, and dynamically clustered across heterogeneous edge devices and applications. To address these research gaps, we introduced Clustered Edge Intelligence, a visionary intelligence-centric approach. The aim of CEI is to make intelligence a shareable and reusable first-class entity that can be independently represented, discovered, observed, exchanged, and managed across the distributed edge-cloud continuum. We present a three layer CEI architecture and examine enabling technologies and research dimensions, including intelligence inventories, semantic knowledge representation, communication, discoverability, observability, lifecycle automation, clustering mechanisms, marketplaces, interoperability, and standardization.

</details>


### [299] [From Scalars to Time Series: Rethinking Implicit Neural Representations for Time-Varying Volumetric Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20970)
*Weihan Zhang,Xuan Zhao,Yenwen Peng,Yuqi Chen,Jun Tao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的序列级INR框架，将时变体数据重新表示为空间索引的时间序列，以空间坐标为输入、时间序列为输出，避免密集时空采样，显著降低训练成本并提升压缩效率。该框架与现有INR架构兼容，并可结合混合专家（MoE）架构进一步提升重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于INR的时变体数据压缩方法采用坐标到标量的密集采样范式，需要大量时空采样点，导致计算成本高、训练时间长（通常数小时至数天），且未能充分利用时间维度的结构化连贯性。空间分区或时间分解策略虽能部分缓解问题，但仍依赖密集采样并可能破坏连续性。本文旨在从学习单元的角度重新思考，将每个空间位置建模为完整的时间序列而非独立的时空标量，从而消除密集时空采样的必要性并更好地捕获时序结构。

Method: 1. 序列级重构：将时变体数据重新定义为映射 F(x) = [V^(1)(x), V^(2)(x), ..., V^(T)(x)]，每个空间位置关联完整时间序列，网络直接从3D坐标预测长度为T的时间序列。2. MoE-INR架构实例化：包含空间编码器（采用可学习谐波位置编码+Sine激活+残差块）、路由模块（融合空间特征与可学习全局时间嵌入，经softmax实现硬路由）以及解码器（共享基础权重W0 + 专家级LoRA低秩适配Wk = W0 + AkBk，秩r=8）。3. 优化策略：前10% epoch用聚类伪标签交叉熵损失预热路由网络，然后端到端以MSE序列损失联合优化，硬路由激活单个专家。4. 训练配置：300 epoch，batch size=1600，Adam优化器（lr=10^-5），输入输出归一化至[-1,1]。5. 默认7个专家，配合谐波位置编码与全局时间嵌入表（T×M）提供时空感知路由信号。

Result: 在5个数据集（argon bubble, combustion, ionization, vortex, Tangaroa）上，方法在PSNR/HD/LPIPS/DreamSim等指标上对标SIREN、CoordNet、NeurComp、Switch-NeRF、Neural Experts、MoE-INR等INR方法以及ZFP、SZ3、TTHRESH等传统压缩器均具有竞争力。压缩加速42.6×–59.9×，解压加速25.7×–38.0×（平均49.2×/31.5×）。在ionization（PD）数据集上PSNR达57.89 dB为最优；在vortex上HD最佳且与MoE-INR接近。同等PSNR下压缩比比传统压缩器高9.6×–102.2×。消融实验表明LoRA减少约20%参数且保持质量，时间嵌入提升PSNR约2–3 dB并降低LPIPS，10% warm-up比为最优。序列长度增长时重建质量轻微下降但前向传播时间近线性。连续多帧解码时解压时间近乎常数（T=1到T=16：vortex 6.99→7.42 s，combustion 25.38→25.91 s），显著优于随帧数线性增长的基线。局限在于对超高频低空域相关时序（如combustion CHI）序列预测仍具挑战，且未显式建模相邻坐标间时空相关性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的序列级INR框架将时变体数据重新表示为空间索引的时间序列，将学习单元从标量预测转为序列级建模，避免了密集时空采样，在多个数据集上实现显著的训练与推理效率提升（压缩~49×、解压~32×）并保持竞争力的重建质量。该框架与现有INR架构兼容，结合MoE + LoRA + 可学习时间嵌入的实例化在异质时序动态建模上表现优越。局限包括对复杂高频时序的质量退化及缺失显式空间-时间相关性建模，未来可探索自适应专家选择、张量分解结构先验及非结构化数据扩展。

Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) for time-varying volumetric data are typically trained using dense sampling over spatiotemporal coordinates, where each observation corresponds to a single point in space and time. This coordinate-wise formulation requires extensive sampling during optimization, leading to high computational cost and inefficient use of temporal structure. In this work, we revisit this design choice and show that dense spatiotemporal sampling is not necessary for learning time-varying fields. Instead, we represent the data as a collection of spatially indexed time series and train INRs using sequence-level supervision over each spatial location, rather than coordinate-wise scalar samples. This reformulation eliminates the need for dense spatiotemporal sampling and instead learns each spatial location from its full temporal evolution in a structured manner. We demonstrate that this representation is compatible with a range of existing INR architectures and consistently improves reconstruction quality, while significantly reducing training cost. Furthermore, we show that this formulation can be combined with mixture-of-experts architectures, and that our MoE instantiation further improves reconstruction quality compared to both the base reformulation and existing MoE-based INR methods, providing a stronger capacity allocation under heterogeneous temporal dynamics.

</details>


### [300] [Delivery, Not Storage: Cue-Anchored Working Memory as a Harness Property for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20972)
*Swapnanil Saha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"提示锚定工作记忆"机制，主张编码智能体的第二层记忆（情境绑定的操作事实）应是harness的属性而非agent的自主选择。核心论点是：当前智能体仅有"文档记忆"（主动写入与读取），缺乏人类专家记忆中"无意识编码、情境线索触发"的关键层次。实验表明，即使预置记忆库，voluntary memory使用率近乎为零（114轮0次操作），而由harness确定性注入的记忆则可靠传递——在138次压缩后仍完整送达。该机制区分content plane（内容追加）与control plane（控制上下文构建），并通过可组合的触发条件词汇（path、symbol、semantic、event、temporal）实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前编码智能体（如Claude Code）依赖CLAUDE.md、plan文件、自动生成的memory目录等"文档型记忆"——必须由agent主动写入与读取。然而人类工程师依赖的第二层记忆（项目gotchas、位置、本地约定）从未被显式记录，而是在工作过程中作为副作用被无意识编码、在情境线索触发时不由自主地被检索出来。这一层次才是长期运行agent的关键支柱。现有方案（给agent提供memory工具）已被证明失败：MEMTRACK基准测试显示智能体在长跨度内系统性地无法利用memory；TriggerBench揭示智能体难以在被提示时执行潜在的待办意图（前瞻性记忆），且随上下文增长性能下降。厂商（如Anthropic、ChatGPT）已在自家产品中变相承认此问题。

Method: （1）设计理论：基于认知科学的"偶发编码"（incidental encoding）、"线索驱动检索"、"事件型前瞻性记忆"与"扩展心智标准"（endorsement criterion）建立双层记忆模型，将每种认知机制映射为可证伪的架构需求。
